--selftest ; bash scripts/check-doc-budgets.sh 4 The sweep's fail-open closes; its selftest stops being the corpus's hostage 1 pds-w45-sweep-failopen scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh opus bash scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh --selftest 5 A criterion names the CLAIM, not the container 1 pds-w45-criterion-venue .claude/workflows/bp-epic-cycle.workflow.js opus node --check .claude/workflows/bp-epic-cycle.workflow.js 6 The ledger stops lying by silence: orphan, retire, dupe, THROUGH shape, evidenced UNMEASURED 2 (after 2) pds-w45-census-ledger-integrity scripts/pds-door-census.sh (cond + rot check + selftest) opus bash scripts/pds-door-census.sh --selftest ; --check ; shellcheck -S error ; mix test pds_door_census_test.exs 7 The price column learns to expire: content key, PRICE-STALE, --measure 3 (after 6) pds-w45-price-provenance scripts/pds-door-census.sh (key + verb) opus bash scripts/pds-door-census.sh --check ; --selftest ; --measure ; mix test pds_door_census_test.exs 8 The hetzner offline arm becomes door 5 of 20 — FIVE edits, THREE files 4 (after 6, 7) pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door rider + escape-check x2 + census ledger x2 opus bash scripts/elixir-path-escape-check.sh --selftest ; --match test ; pds-door-census.sh --check ; mix test HIGH-FLIP-RISK, declared. Slice 1 — whether a Code.compile_string substitution proves what a tautology did not, on a LIVE authorization door, and whether the repair stays out of api/lib and therefore out of Console's fence. Slice 2 — whether the argument-list predicate still admits a fraudulent THROUGH, and whether it now DECLINES an honest door; the fix must be proven in BOTH directions and the Port.open arm is the second-direction oracle. Slice 6 — whether the retire shape is a bypass, and whether the orphan check has a false-positive mode. All three warrant a genuinely INDEPENDENT second reviewer before merge; this workflow spawns one reviewer, so that dispatch is the lead's manual step. ROUNDS ARE LAW. Slices 6, 7 and 8 all edit scripts/pds-door-census.sh and are strictly sequenced behind slice 2 and each other. They do NOT build this run; the lead dispatches each after its dependency MERGES. A round-1 slice whose dependency is unmerged burns a builder to produce a BLOCKED report. FABLE WAS UNAVAILABLE. Every slice is built at opus@medium, including three (2, 6, 7) that are genuinely hard on the difficulty axis and would otherwise have gone to fable. That is a recorded constraint, not a judgment that these slices are routine. BACKLOG FILED — the future, not just the present task id what priority pds-w45-bl-sweep-adjudication-frozen-blob Adjudicate the sweep's 59 arrivals against a FROZEN BLOB SHA, never a count. 13 of them are a LENS repair, not judgment; bucket 'reflow' is empty. 1 pds-w45-bl-grant-door-untested-arms Three untested arms in the merged grant door (grant_graded?'s OR, write_target_scope's fail-closed, doc_field totality) plus a denial flash with TWO producers that cannot say which door refused. 1 pds-w45-bl-ledger-census-lazy-urllib The 144-check harness costs 144 interpreter boots, not 144 checks. Lazy urllib is 2 lines for -29% CPU, measured. Refuse the cheap-arm/expensive-arm split. 2 pds-w45-bl-scratch-target-class-refuted Its hermeticity refusal is REFUTED by run, and the remaining PRICE clause has no predicate — the census has no numeric threshold anywhere. 2 pds-w45-bl-receipt-census-self-claims The census misstates its own gating on merged code, and hand-types two numbers inside the very @blind_spot list D633 built to stop that. 2 pds-w45-bl-foreign-runner-first-door No pds door has ever run on a foreign CI runner. D648 already directs that CI overwrite the local figure; nothing ever has. 2 pds-w44-lv-verdict-unresolved-spec-arm SUPERSEDED by PDS-D661 and demoted to priority 4 — left open only as a tripwire for the day declined_live stops being 0. 4 A note on what this wave refused to do. Rival A — 'pay the debts, period' — would have shipped two of its own three slices into an instrument they silently corrupt: hetzner-offline manufactures the orphaned ENVIRONMENT row, and the sweep adjudication makes CONTENT-RED outlive its red. That is why the ledger-integrity slice is a PREREQUISITE for the wish's own item 2 and not a tangent. And the sharpest attack on the winner — that 'measured versus cached-with-provenance' is philosophy, not a defect — was answered not by argument but by a run: the shipped census prices a gutted two-line harness at 4.45 s and 76 checks, and its 40.33 s row is wrong by 40% today. DEBRIEF — what shipped, what it cost, and the grade Reviewed 2026-08-03 by the wave reviewer, in an isolated worktree, with every gate re-run on the FINAL branch rather than read from a builder report. Five of five round-1 slices are green and PUSHED with PRs open; three round-2+ slices were deferred by design and their tasks say so. Grade: A. WHAT SHIPPED — per slice, with the branch the lead should integrate. Three branches carry a reviewer commit on top of the builder commit; two are the builder branch unchanged, because the diff was correct as built and there was nothing honest to add. task final branch PR gate re-run on the final state verdict pds-w45-grant-door-nonvacuity loop-epic/9377-s-non-vacuity-stops-being-a-tautolo-0-r #9433 mix test pds_w44_grant_door_test.exs -> 5 tests, 0 failures; mix format --check-formatted rc=0 The tautology is gone and replaced by a real substitution on the SHIPPED module. REVIEWER FIX (c07e9fcb2): the guard was mutant != original, which proves only that SOMETHING was replaced; global: false takes the FIRST match, so it now pins the expression to EXACTLY ONE occurrence. Proven by mutation: an absent expression reds AT the new guard. pds-w45-lega-argument-list loop-epic/leg-a-reads-the-argument-list-not-the-ne-1-r #9434 selftest 14 PASS / 0 FAIL; --check rc=0 and BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-review baseline; shellcheck -S error rc=0; mix test pds_door_census_test.exs 8 tests, 0 failures Membership replaces proximity in both directions, and the enumerator stops dying silently. REVIEWER FIX (08a5b74ee): FRAUD D — the span balanced the parens but returned the WHOLE closing line, so a token named AFTER the closing paren still read as membership. Now cut to the paren column; the arm reds LEGA-BOUND-EXEC on revert. pds-w44-judgment-coverage-ladder loop-epic/proven-backed-as-a-union-never-an-additi-2 (unchanged) #9438 census rc=0; --selftest rc=0, 34 cases / 23 mutants incl. PASS LADDER-UNION-NOT-SUM; check-doc-budgets PASS The strongest slice of the wave. The number 23 is worthless as evidence (OVERLAP is 0), the builder knew it, and shipped the only thing that can discriminate — a count-free relation token, verified red in the other direction. The doc figures were re-derived from MY run, not the report: JUDGED 67, EXCLUDED 178, 74/252 = 29.4%, all match. pds-w45-sweep-failopen loop-epic/the-charter-sweep-s-fail-open-closes-and-3-r #9441 sweep --selftest rc=0 "SELFTEST OK: 3 of 3"; door census --check rc=0, --selftest 8/8, shellcheck rc=0 The fail-open is closed and I re-derived it INDEPENDENTLY: an expired-token shim over a pinned ledger snapshot now gives rc=2 UNCHECKED naming the slug, where before it was byte-identical to a healthy run. REVIEWER FIX (6c42cf3e6): the census row that describes this instrument co-lands, because the sweep fix alone makes that row a stale receipt. pds-w45-criterion-venue loop-epic/a-criterion-names-the-claim-not-the-cont-4 (unchanged) #9442 node --check rc=0 One additive bullet, epic-neutral, purely additive: full-file diff is one hunk 137a138, and the merge-gated row shifted 141 -> 142 byte-identical (cmp: 189 bytes, re-derived by me). Cheapest slice in the wave and it retroactively unblocks unstamped criteria on merged work. WHAT STALLED — nothing. Three slices were deferred by the sequenced-rounds law, each on a hard dependency that has to merge first: pds-w45-census-ledger-integrity (round 2, after #9434 — same file, ~180 lines move), pds-w45-price-provenance (round 3, after round 2 — same file, built on top), pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door (round 4, after both — it needs the retire shape and --measure those rounds create). Their tasks are open, unclaimed and 0/N met, which is the honest state, not a stall. THE TWO FINDINGS REVIEW ADDED, AND THE RULES THEY BUY PDS-D664 — A REPAIRED PREDICATE CARRIES ITS OLD DEFECT FOR EXACTLY ONE LINE. arg_span replaced the three-line proximity window with a real paren-balance walk, and the three fraud shapes flipped as designed. It still returned the whole CLOSING LINE, so "System.cmd(...) ; File.regular?(@fraud)" — a token named after the closing paren, on the call's own line — still read as argument-list membership: bound, never executed, THROUGH with a price. One line of the old window living inside the new predicate, past a 13-arm green selftest. THE RULE: when you replace a window with a boundary, the boundary is where the window's last residue hides — test the token that sits just OUTSIDE the new edge, not only the ones that sat inside the old one. PDS-D665 — BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER APPLIES TO EVIDENCE STRINGS, NOT ONLY TO DECLARED PATH SETS. The wish states the both-legs law for the hetzner slice's ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry. It bit somewhere nobody named: the sweep's own fix makes --selftest rc=0, which turns the door census row whose evidence quotes "--selftest rc=1" into a stale receipt the moment it merges — on the instrument whose entire subject is receipts that lie. The builder was fenced out of the census and correctly recorded the correction in two durable venues rather than reaching across the fence. Review co-landed the one-line row edit on the SAME branch: a behaviour and the receipt describing it merge together or not at all. A fence that splits those two has to be closed by whoever holds both, and the fix belongs on the branch that causes the drift. LEDGER AUDIT — three fixes, and one defect the audit itself surfaced Every slice task was claimed before work, stamped mid-claim with real evidence rather than batched at the end, and left in_progress with only the merge-gated row open — with one exception, now fixed. Tasks outside this wave were not touched. pds-w45-criterion-venue sat at lifecycle_status=open while HOLDING a live claim with 7 criteria stamped — a worked, claimed row reading as unstarted on every board. Re-claimed as the reviewer (epoch 9) so the lifecycle matches reality: in_progress, 8/9 met. pds-w45-criterion-venue[4] ("The lead-owned merge-gated row ... is EXPLICITLY EXEMPTED and is left byte-identical") was PROVEN but UNSTAMPED: bp task stamp refuses any --criterion-text containing the substring "merge-gated", so a row that DESCRIBES the gated row is refused as though it WERE one. Re-derived independently (cmp on the two lines: IDENTICAL, 189 bytes; full-file diff one hunk 137a138) and stamped with the override, with that provenance in the evidence. pds-w45-census-row-check-evidence — filed by the sweep builder as follow-up work — was DONE by the reviewer commit on the sweep branch. Claimed, its single criterion stamped with the new row verbatim plus four runs, and left in_progress: it closes when #9441 merges. The stamp-guard defect is NOT newly filed: it duplicates pds-w27-bl-stamp-guard-substring-false-positive (wave 27, still open, root-caused to internal/cli/tasks_stamp_cmd.go). A new task was created, the server flagged the duplicate, and it was DELETED rather than left to double-count the backlog. The recurrence is recorded here instead. Three follow-ups filed BY THE BUILDERS are published children of the epic and honest: pds-w45-argspan-sigil-and-silent-bound (sigil-blind blanking, the silent 40-line bound), task-ac55ff2388510d67 (the ladder's :stale arm is a NO-OP and nothing proves it), pds-w45-census-row-check-evidence (above). GRADE — A WHAT EARNS IT. The wave paid all three items the wish named and paid them in the order the dependencies allow. The second-review debt on #9377 is now discharged BY THE MERGING ARTIFACT rather than by a reviewer's hand mutation — that was the live gap on merged code, and it is the difference between "someone proved it once" and "the repo proves it every run". The ladder slice is the wave's best work: it recognised that its own headline number is evidence of nothing, said so in the printed output, and shipped the only discriminator that exists as a selftest case verified in both directions. The sweep slice reproduced its fail-open with the CORRECT oracle after the criterion named the wrong one, and closed it with the discriminator that was already on the wire. Four of five slices refuted something in their own dispatch by run — the eleventh, twelfth and thirteenth consecutive refutations — and each wrote the correction into the artifact instead of quietly satisfying a figure that does not exist. WHAT KEEPS IT OFF A+. Two of the five needed a reviewer fix to a predicate that had just been tightened, and in both cases the defect was one step past where the builder stopped looking: the first occurrence rather than the only occurrence, the closing line rather than the closing paren. Both slices had green, honest, non-vacuous selftests through the defect. The wave also left three real UNPROVEN arms shipping green by print rather than by mutation — the ladder's :stale filter, arg_span's "every call opening on the line" clause, and its 40-line bound — each filed, none closed, and each is exactly the shape this epic exists to refuse. And every price and timing in this wave is LOCAL: no PDS door has yet run on a foreign runner, so the price column remains an instrument calibrated against one host. NOT A CRITICISM, ON THE RECORD: the wish's item 4 (the unbuilt "?" variable-bound decline) was RULED OUT with a reason, not quietly dropped — PDS-D661 — and the ladder slice printed declined_live=0 as a BOUND on the sentence instead, derived THROUGH lvs_joinable?/1 so the number cannot drift from the predicate it describes. Ruling it out was the right half of "finish it or rule it out". WHAT THE NEXT WAVE TAKES MERGE ORDER FIRST. The five round-1 PRs are file-disjoint except that #9434 and #9441 both touch scripts/pds-door-census.sh — #9434 in the classifier and the selftest, #9441 at line 123 of PDS_DOOR_DISPOSITIONS only — so either order merges without a conflict. Then dispatch the deferred slices STRICTLY in dependency order, re-deriving every anchor at each merged base, because each one moves the file the next one reads. order slice dispatches after why the order is not negotiable 1 pds-w45-census-ledger-integrity #9434 merges Same file; the leg-A repair moves ~180 lines and every anchor in its brief is a line number. 2 pds-w45-price-provenance round 2 merges Built on top of the retire shape and the orphan check; the elided-key design assumes them. 3 pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door rounds 2 AND 3 merge It needs --measure to add its price row and the retire shape to dispose the orphaned ENVIRONMENT row. BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER: the instrument AND its ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry, or it is #9290/#9292 a third time. THEN WAVE 46'S OWN WORK, in the order the census's printed output ranks it: adjudicate the sweep's 59 unresolved-claim arrivals (the vocabulary is mined from the charter and THIS wave's charter PR moved it again, which is precisely why it could not be done here); price the receipt census's UNMEASURED-LOCAL expensive arm; and either justify or tier pds-ledger-census_test.sh at 40.33 s CPU on a 2-4 vCPU runner rather than shrugging at it. One standing debt outranks all of them for credibility: NO pds door has ever been measured on a foreign runner, so every figure in the price column is a loaded local mac. THE SECOND-REVIEWER DEBT, NAMED RATHER THAN ASSUMED DISCHARGED. #9433 is a HIGH-FLIP-RISK slice on a live grant/tenancy door, and this workflow spawns exactly ONE reviewer — so the independent second pass is a MANUAL LEAD STEP before merge. I re-derived the substitution from source and mutation-proved my own guard, but a genuinely independent pair of eyes on the authorization judgment is still owed. Every PR here also carries an open MERGE-GATED criterion that is the lead's to close on merge: #9433[8], #9434[10], #9438[14], #9441[9], #9442[8].

390.title: PDS wave 45 - the price column learns to expire

desktop.bodyText: PDS wave 45 - the price column learns to expire STRATEGIZE COMPLETE - the survey fleet is flying. GROUND TRUTH, DERIVED IN-PROCESS at origin/main ab8c86b05 in a detached worktree, never the primary checkout (which is stale at a31faa52d and dirty across eight charters). I ran scripts/pds-door-census.sh myself: rc=0, ERRORS 0, every program disposed. THE HEADLINE THE WISH DID NOT ASK FOR: the census runs in 4.13 s wall / 2.80 s CPU - so it CANNOT have taken the 40.33 s CPU / 68.24 s wall figure it prints. Every price and every disposition-evidence string is a hardcoded literal in PDS_DOOR_PRICES (:146-149) and PDS_DOOR_DISPOSITIONS (:123-137). The CLASS column became an instrument in wave 44. The PRICE column became a shell variable with a date stamp. And the denominator is 20 with 4 doors, not the 19 with 3 that both the wish and the lead notes carry - the census counts itself, and says so at :12-14. What I ran, and what it refuted Eleven consecutive waves have refuted their own dispatch from the artifact. This is the twelfth, and the refutations are load-bearing rather than cosmetic - three of the five figures the brief and the lead notes hand down are contradicted by the instrument on merged main. PREMISE, AS HANDED DOWN RE-DERIVED AT AB8C86B05 CONSEQUENCE "the door count is 3 of 19, not an unmeasured N" (lead notes, emphatic) THE COLUMN prints population 20 (18 .sh + 2 .exs), THROUGH 4 of 20 - pds-door-census.sh, pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs, pds-record-parity.test.sh, pds-status-only-residue.exs The census entered its own denominator by design (:12-14: "a census that hid itself would be the first thing it exists to catch"). 3-of-19 was true before #9380 merged. Do not quote it. "prints a class + a MEASURED PRICE or a named blocker with file:line" (wish item, the wave's whole claim) HALF TRUE. Class is computed: leg A is three mechanical predicates over the tree, leg B is evaluated by EXECUTING elixir-path-escape-check.sh. Price is a string literal. Timed: real 4,13 / user 0,81 / sys 1,99 for the entire run. THE WAVE'S SPINE. A 4-second program cannot have measured a 68-second row. "my 'exactly three refusal reasons' is FIVE by run plus a sixth (HUMAN-GATE)" The VOCABULARY is six (:105-115). The classes actually USED by a row on main are five: ENVIRONMENT (11), PRICE (2), CONTENT-RED (1), RED-BY-DESIGN-REPORTER (1), NOT-YET-BUILT (1). HUMAN-GATE is used by ZERO rows. The correction is right in direction and still not the run's number. A vocabulary entry no row exercises is itself an untested arm. "pds-live-hetzner-placement-group.sh - ENVIRONMENT, needs HCLOUD_TOKEN" (shipped disposition, :128) The CLASS is defensible; the EVIDENCE is about the wrong arm. It cites `--selftest` rc=3. The script's own header at :12-13 and :964 declares `--selftest-offline` "the CREDENTIAL-FREE arm and the CI-able gate". I ran it: rc=0, CPU 1.06+1.09 = 2.15 s at load1 15.44. A LIVE FALSEHOOD-BY-OMISSION in the shipped instrument, and the second-cheapest arm in the whole inventory sitting behind it. "pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh is CONTENT-RED, rc=1 today" (wish item 3) Confirmed as printed - but the census does not RUN it. The string "by run 2026-08-03 ... rc=1" is a literal at :123. The wish's own slice 3 takes this row to rc=0. The census will keep printing CONTENT-RED. The three blind spots, and why two of them are this wave's own doing The census has exactly one rot check, at :585-602, and it tests EXISTENCE: a ledger row naming a file that is no longer on disk is an error. That catches deletion. It cannot catch the three shapes that actually rot a price column. STALE PRICE. No content hash, no date arithmetic, no re-measurement. pds-record-parity.test.sh will print CPU=4.45s after someone doubles the harness's work, forever, and nothing reds. STALE DISPOSITION EVIDENCE. Five rows cite "by run 2026-08-03: <cmd> rc=N". The census never re-takes any of them. A disposition survives its own repair. ORPHANED DISPOSITION. Read the cond at :519-540: legA=yes AND legB=true short-circuits to THROUGH and the ledger is NEVER consulted. A disposition row for a now-THROUGH instrument is silently unread - not an error, not a warning, not printed. THE COUPLING THAT MAKES THIS THE SPINE RATHER THAN A TANGENT: two of the three deferred slices the wish orders will make the census lie the day they land. pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door puts --selftest-offline through a rider plus ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS - legA/legB then compute THROUGH and the ENVIRONMENT row at :128 becomes an unflagged orphan asserting a refusal that is no longer the disposition. pds-w44-charter-sweep-adjudication takes the sweep from rc=1 to rc=0 - and CONTENT-RED, evidenced by a run nobody re-takes, outlives the red it names. Price provenance is a PREREQUISITE for the wish's own item 2, not an addition to it. The direction The epic's law has walked one rung per wave. A receipt lies when the value it emits does not descend from the write return. A class lies when it does not descend from its substitution (wave 42). A gate lies when its green costs nothing to produce (wave 43). Wave 45's sentence is the one the new instrument earns: A PRICE LIES WHEN IT DOES NOT DESCEND FROM A METER THE INSTRUMENT ITSELF DROVE - AND A DISPOSITION LIES WHEN ITS EVIDENCE NAMES A RUN THE INSTRUMENT NEVER RE-TAKES. What the finished wave looks like: ./scripts/pds-door-census.sh still exits 0 on main and still costs seconds - it is a door, and its own 3.32 s row is its own gate cost, so any design that prices it out of its own door is disqualified before it is written. But every number it prints is now either taken by a meter it drove in THIS run, or a cached measurement carrying the content hash of the instrument it prices, so that a changed instrument turns the row PRICE-STALE and reds. A --measure verb takes the measurement and emits the exact ledger row, so re-pricing is one command rather than a hand ritual - the number descends from a meter the instrument drove, and anyone can re-take it. Dispositions whose evidence is a RUN get re-run under an opt-in, threshold-printed tier, so CONTENT-RED cannot survive its own repair. And an orphaned ledger row is an ERROR, because that is the exact shape both of this wave's own slices create. Around that spine, the debts get paid at the new base. Priority order, and the reasoning behind it: # WHAT WHY IT SITS HERE 1 #9377's SHIPPED non-vacuity test is a stub - make it real, then review The only item on this list that is a LIVE GAP ON MERGED CODE. Wave 44's reviewer re-proved the narrowing by hand-mutation; the merging artifact cannot reproduce that proof. A security fix whose non-vacuity cannot be re-run is a stamped receipt that overstates. This outranks the spine on urgency, not on scope. 2 Price provenance, expiry, and orphan detection in pds-door-census.sh The spine. Unblocks slices 4 and 5 from corrupting the instrument. 3 #9380's genuinely independent second review - 37 KB of shell, one pair of eyes D649 declared leg A's three predicates HIGH-FLIP-RISK and named the comment mutation as the oracle. It never got its builder's own review dispatch. 4 pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door - BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER, plus its census row I measured the arm today: rc=0, 2.15 s CPU. The cheapest unclaimed door in the inventory. It also carries the wave's sharpest overlap risk. 5 pds-w44-charter-sweep-adjudication - 45 rulings, and the fail-open at :203 Vocabulary is mined from the charter, which has now landed - and wave 44's own wave-log entry moved it again. Its bp_json(allow_error=True) fail-open is this epic's law broken inside the instrument that enforces it. 6 pds-w44-judgment-coverage-ladder at the new base #9378 shifted every line number. PROVEN-BACKED must be ONE Enum.count over ONE MapSet.union, taken once, never leg_a + leg_b. Its numbers have been dead three times. 7 lv_verdict/5's '?' variable-bound decline - finish properly or rule out with a reason Wave 44 recorded a non-build rather than shipping a cond reorder it could not justify. That was correct. It is still owed a disposition. 8 The criterion-venue rubric fix Cheap, and it prevents a whole class of unmeetable criteria: name the CLAIM, accept any durable venue. The direction debate Three directions were developed far enough to cost something, then argued against each other. Rival A - pay the debts, period Do exactly the wish's items 1 through 5: three deferred slices, two owed reviews, the lv_verdict half, the criterion lesson. Do not touch the census - it exits 0, wave 44 declared it done, and reopening it is a fifth wave of arguing about a column. This is the disciplined reading of the brief and it has a real claim on the wave. WHY IT LOSES: it hands the wave a false floor. Two of its own three slices silently corrupt the instrument, so "pay the debts" manufactures the next wave's finding. And it violates the mandate the user restates every single wave - DERIVE, NEVER TRANSCRIBE, INCLUDING FROM THIS BRIEF - by inheriting "the price column is an instrument now" as a premise instead of running it. I ran it. It is half an instrument, and the half that is prose is the half the column is named after. Rival B - measure every price, every run The pure fix: no cache, no ledger, no staleness possible. The census drives the meter for every row on every invocation and the price column is a measurement by construction. WHY IT LOSES, on the epic's own evidence: D648 proved wall is not a property of a door on a shared host - a fixed workload's wall spanned 5.8x at constant load while its user CPU spanned 27 percent. A re-measuring census becomes the most expensive program in its own denominator: 40.33 s for pds-ledger-census_test.sh alone, plus the receipt census whose expensive arm D646 showed conceals ~140 s minimum from any outer meter. It would also have to price ITSELF - a fixpoint. Worst of all it converts a 4 s door into an ungateable one, killing the census's own THROUGH row, which is the single most self-defeating outcome available to this wave. The honest design is not "always measure" but "never assert a measurement you cannot re-take, and know when it expired." The fail-open is independent of all that. --match test ; pds-door-census.sh --check ; mix test HIGH-FLIP-RISK, declared. Slice 1 — whether a Code.compile_string substitution proves what a tautology did not, on a LIVE authorization door, and whether the repair stays out of api/lib and therefore out of Console's fence. Slice 2 — whether the argument-list predicate still admits a fraudulent THROUGH, and whether it now DECLINES an honest door; the fix must be proven in BOTH directions and the Port.open arm is the second-direction oracle. Slice 6 — whether the retire shape is a bypass, and whether the orphan check has a false-positive mode. All three warrant a genuinely INDEPENDENT second reviewer before merge; this workflow spawns one reviewer, so that dispatch is the lead's manual step. ROUNDS ARE LAW. Slices 6, 7 and 8 all edit scripts/pds-door-census.sh and are strictly sequenced behind slice 2 and each other. They do NOT build this run; the lead dispatches each after its dependency MERGES. A round-1 slice whose dependency is unmerged burns a builder to produce a BLOCKED report. FABLE WAS UNAVAILABLE. Every slice is built at opus@medium, including three (2, 6, 7) that are genuinely hard on the difficulty axis and would otherwise have gone to fable. That is a recorded constraint, not a judgment that these slices are routine. BACKLOG FILED — the future, not just the present task id what priority pds-w45-bl-sweep-adjudication-frozen-blob Adjudicate the sweep's 59 arrivals against a FROZEN BLOB SHA, never a count. 13 of them are a LENS repair, not judgment; bucket 'reflow' is empty. 1 pds-w45-bl-grant-door-untested-arms Three untested arms in the merged grant door (grant_graded?'s OR, write_target_scope's fail-closed, doc_field totality) plus a denial flash with TWO producers that cannot say which door refused. 1 pds-w45-bl-ledger-census-lazy-urllib The 144-check harness costs 144 interpreter boots, not 144 checks. Lazy urllib is 2 lines for -29% CPU, measured. Refuse the cheap-arm/expensive-arm split. 2 pds-w45-bl-scratch-target-class-refuted Its hermeticity refusal is REFUTED by run, and the remaining PRICE clause has no predicate — the census has no numeric threshold anywhere. 2 pds-w45-bl-receipt-census-self-claims The census misstates its own gating on merged code, and hand-types two numbers inside the very @blind_spot list D633 built to stop that. 2 pds-w45-bl-foreign-runner-first-door No pds door has ever run on a foreign CI runner. D648 already directs that CI overwrite the local figure; nothing ever has. 2 pds-w44-lv-verdict-unresolved-spec-arm SUPERSEDED by PDS-D661 and demoted to priority 4 — left open only as a tripwire for the day declined_live stops being 0. 4 A note on what this wave refused to do. Rival A — 'pay the debts, period' — would have shipped two of its own three slices into an instrument they silently corrupt: hetzner-offline manufactures the orphaned ENVIRONMENT row, and the sweep adjudication makes CONTENT-RED outlive its red. That is why the ledger-integrity slice is a PREREQUISITE for the wish's own item 2 and not a tangent. And the sharpest attack on the winner — that 'measured versus cached-with-provenance' is philosophy, not a defect — was answered not by argument but by a run: the shipped census prices a gutted two-line harness at 4.45 s and 76 checks, and its 40.33 s row is wrong by 40% today. DEBRIEF — what shipped, what it cost, and the grade Reviewed 2026-08-03 by the wave reviewer, in an isolated worktree, with every gate re-run on the FINAL branch rather than read from a builder report. Five of five round-1 slices are green and PUSHED with PRs open; three round-2+ slices were deferred by design and their tasks say so. Grade: A. WHAT SHIPPED — per slice, with the branch the lead should integrate. Three branches carry a reviewer commit on top of the builder commit; two are the builder branch unchanged, because the diff was correct as built and there was nothing honest to add. task final branch PR gate re-run on the final state verdict pds-w45-grant-door-nonvacuity loop-epic/9377-s-non-vacuity-stops-being-a-tautolo-0-r #9433 mix test pds_w44_grant_door_test.exs -> 5 tests, 0 failures; mix format --check-formatted rc=0 The tautology is gone and replaced by a real substitution on the SHIPPED module. REVIEWER FIX (c07e9fcb2): the guard was mutant != original, which proves only that SOMETHING was replaced; global: false takes the FIRST match, so it now pins the expression to EXACTLY ONE occurrence. Proven by mutation: an absent expression reds AT the new guard. pds-w45-lega-argument-list loop-epic/leg-a-reads-the-argument-list-not-the-ne-1-r #9434 selftest 14 PASS / 0 FAIL; --check rc=0 and BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-review baseline; shellcheck -S error rc=0; mix test pds_door_census_test.exs 8 tests, 0 failures Membership replaces proximity in both directions, and the enumerator stops dying silently. REVIEWER FIX (08a5b74ee): FRAUD D — the span balanced the parens but returned the WHOLE closing line, so a token named AFTER the closing paren still read as membership. Now cut to the paren column; the arm reds LEGA-BOUND-EXEC on revert. pds-w44-judgment-coverage-ladder loop-epic/proven-backed-as-a-union-never-an-additi-2 (unchanged) #9438 census rc=0; --selftest rc=0, 34 cases / 23 mutants incl. PASS LADDER-UNION-NOT-SUM; check-doc-budgets PASS The strongest slice of the wave. The number 23 is worthless as evidence (OVERLAP is 0), the builder knew it, and shipped the only thing that can discriminate — a count-free relation token, verified red in the other direction. The doc figures were re-derived from MY run, not the report: JUDGED 67, EXCLUDED 178, 74/252 = 29.4%, all match. pds-w45-sweep-failopen loop-epic/the-charter-sweep-s-fail-open-closes-and-3-r #9441 sweep --selftest rc=0 "SELFTEST OK: 3 of 3"; door census --check rc=0, --selftest 8/8, shellcheck rc=0 The fail-open is closed and I re-derived it INDEPENDENTLY: an expired-token shim over a pinned ledger snapshot now gives rc=2 UNCHECKED naming the slug, where before it was byte-identical to a healthy run. REVIEWER FIX (6c42cf3e6): the census row that describes this instrument co-lands, because the sweep fix alone makes that row a stale receipt. pds-w45-criterion-venue loop-epic/a-criterion-names-the-claim-not-the-cont-4 (unchanged) #9442 node --check rc=0 One additive bullet, epic-neutral, purely additive: full-file diff is one hunk 137a138, and the merge-gated row shifted 141 -> 142 byte-identical (cmp: 189 bytes, re-derived by me). Cheapest slice in the wave and it retroactively unblocks unstamped criteria on merged work. WHAT STALLED — nothing. Three slices were deferred by the sequenced-rounds law, each on a hard dependency that has to merge first: pds-w45-census-ledger-integrity (round 2, after #9434 — same file, ~180 lines move), pds-w45-price-provenance (round 3, after round 2 — same file, built on top), pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door (round 4, after both — it needs the retire shape and --measure those rounds create). Their tasks are open, unclaimed and 0/N met, which is the honest state, not a stall. THE TWO FINDINGS REVIEW ADDED, AND THE RULES THEY BUY PDS-D664 — A REPAIRED PREDICATE CARRIES ITS OLD DEFECT FOR EXACTLY ONE LINE. arg_span replaced the three-line proximity window with a real paren-balance walk, and the three fraud shapes flipped as designed. It still returned the whole CLOSING LINE, so "System.cmd(...) ; File.regular?(@fraud)" — a token named after the closing paren, on the call's own line — still read as argument-list membership: bound, never executed, THROUGH with a price. One line of the old window living inside the new predicate, past a 13-arm green selftest. THE RULE: when you replace a window with a boundary, the boundary is where the window's last residue hides — test the token that sits just OUTSIDE the new edge, not only the ones that sat inside the old one. PDS-D665 — BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER APPLIES TO EVIDENCE STRINGS, NOT ONLY TO DECLARED PATH SETS. The wish states the both-legs law for the hetzner slice's ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry. It bit somewhere nobody named: the sweep's own fix makes --selftest rc=0, which turns the door census row whose evidence quotes "--selftest rc=1" into a stale receipt the moment it merges — on the instrument whose entire subject is receipts that lie. The builder was fenced out of the census and correctly recorded the correction in two durable venues rather than reaching across the fence. Review co-landed the one-line row edit on the SAME branch: a behaviour and the receipt describing it merge together or not at all. A fence that splits those two has to be closed by whoever holds both, and the fix belongs on the branch that causes the drift. LEDGER AUDIT — three fixes, and one defect the audit itself surfaced Every slice task was claimed before work, stamped mid-claim with real evidence rather than batched at the end, and left in_progress with only the merge-gated row open — with one exception, now fixed. Tasks outside this wave were not touched. pds-w45-criterion-venue sat at lifecycle_status=open while HOLDING a live claim with 7 criteria stamped — a worked, claimed row reading as unstarted on every board. Re-claimed as the reviewer (epoch 9) so the lifecycle matches reality: in_progress, 8/9 met. pds-w45-criterion-venue[4] ("The lead-owned merge-gated row ... is EXPLICITLY EXEMPTED and is left byte-identical") was PROVEN but UNSTAMPED: bp task stamp refuses any --criterion-text containing the substring "merge-gated", so a row that DESCRIBES the gated row is refused as though it WERE one. Re-derived independently (cmp on the two lines: IDENTICAL, 189 bytes; full-file diff one hunk 137a138) and stamped with the override, with that provenance in the evidence. pds-w45-census-row-check-evidence — filed by the sweep builder as follow-up work — was DONE by the reviewer commit on the sweep branch. Claimed, its single criterion stamped with the new row verbatim plus four runs, and left in_progress: it closes when #9441 merges. The stamp-guard defect is NOT newly filed: it duplicates pds-w27-bl-stamp-guard-substring-false-positive (wave 27, still open, root-caused to internal/cli/tasks_stamp_cmd.go). A new task was created, the server flagged the duplicate, and it was DELETED rather than left to double-count the backlog. The recurrence is recorded here instead. Three follow-ups filed BY THE BUILDERS are published children of the epic and honest: pds-w45-argspan-sigil-and-silent-bound (sigil-blind blanking, the silent 40-line bound), task-ac55ff2388510d67 (the ladder's :stale arm is a NO-OP and nothing proves it), pds-w45-census-row-check-evidence (above). GRADE — A WHAT EARNS IT. The wave paid all three items the wish named and paid them in the order the dependencies allow. The second-review debt on #9377 is now discharged BY THE MERGING ARTIFACT rather than by a reviewer's hand mutation — that was the live gap on merged code, and it is the difference between "someone proved it once" and "the repo proves it every run". The ladder slice is the wave's best work: it recognised that its own headline number is evidence of nothing, said so in the printed output, and shipped the only discriminator that exists as a selftest case verified in both directions. The sweep slice reproduced its fail-open with the CORRECT oracle after the criterion named the wrong one, and closed it with the discriminator that was already on the wire. Four of five slices refuted something in their own dispatch by run — the eleventh, twelfth and thirteenth consecutive refutations — and each wrote the correction into the artifact instead of quietly satisfying a figure that does not exist. WHAT KEEPS IT OFF A+. Two of the five needed a reviewer fix to a predicate that had just been tightened, and in both cases the defect was one step past where the builder stopped looking: the first occurrence rather than the only occurrence, the closing line rather than the closing paren. Both slices had green, honest, non-vacuous selftests through the defect. The wave also left three real UNPROVEN arms shipping green by print rather than by mutation — the ladder's :stale filter, arg_span's "every call opening on the line" clause, and its 40-line bound — each filed, none closed, and each is exactly the shape this epic exists to refuse. And every price and timing in this wave is LOCAL: no PDS door has yet run on a foreign runner, so the price column remains an instrument calibrated against one host. NOT A CRITICISM, ON THE RECORD: the wish's item 4 (the unbuilt "?" variable-bound decline) was RULED OUT with a reason, not quietly dropped — PDS-D661 — and the ladder slice printed declined_live=0 as a BOUND on the sentence instead, derived THROUGH lvs_joinable?/1 so the number cannot drift from the predicate it describes. Ruling it out was the right half of "finish it or rule it out". WHAT THE NEXT WAVE TAKES MERGE ORDER FIRST. The five round-1 PRs are file-disjoint except that #9434 and #9441 both touch scripts/pds-door-census.sh — #9434 in the classifier and the selftest, #9441 at line 123 of PDS_DOOR_DISPOSITIONS only — so either order merges without a conflict. Then dispatch the deferred slices STRICTLY in dependency order, re-deriving every anchor at each merged base, because each one moves the file the next one reads. order slice dispatches after why the order is not negotiable 1 pds-w45-census-ledger-integrity #9434 merges Same file; the leg-A repair moves ~180 lines and every anchor in its brief is a line number. 2 pds-w45-price-provenance round 2 merges Built on top of the retire shape and the orphan check; the elided-key design assumes them. 3 pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door rounds 2 AND 3 merge It needs --measure to add its price row and the retire shape to dispose the orphaned ENVIRONMENT row. BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER: the instrument AND its ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry, or it is #9290/#9292 a third time. THEN WAVE 46'S OWN WORK, in the order the census's printed output ranks it: adjudicate the sweep's 59 unresolved-claim arrivals (the vocabulary is mined from the charter and THIS wave's charter PR moved it again, which is precisely why it could not be done here); price the receipt census's UNMEASURED-LOCAL expensive arm; and either justify or tier pds-ledger-census_test.sh at 40.33 s CPU on a 2-4 vCPU runner rather than shrugging at it. One standing debt outranks all of them for credibility: NO pds door has ever been measured on a foreign runner, so every figure in the price column is a loaded local mac. THE SECOND-REVIEWER DEBT, NAMED RATHER THAN ASSUMED DISCHARGED. #9433 is a HIGH-FLIP-RISK slice on a live grant/tenancy door, and this workflow spawns exactly ONE reviewer — so the independent second pass is a MANUAL LEAD STEP before merge. I re-derived the substitution from source and mutation-proved my own guard, but a genuinely independent pair of eyes on the authorization judgment is still owed. Every PR here also carries an open MERGE-GATED criterion that is the lead's to close on merge: #9433[8], #9434[10], #9438[14], #9441[9], #9442[8].

reflow200.bodyText: PDS wave 45 - the price column learns to expire STRATEGIZE COMPLETE - the survey fleet is flying. GROUND TRUTH, DERIVED IN-PROCESS at origin/main ab8c86b05 in a detached worktree, never the primary checkout (which is stale at a31faa52d and dirty across eight charters). THE TWO FINDINGS REVIEW ADDED, AND THE RULES THEY BUY PDS-D664 — A REPAIRED PREDICATE CARRIES ITS OLD DEFECT FOR EXACTLY ONE LINE. arg_span replaced the three-line proximity window with a real paren-balance walk, and the three fraud shapes flipped as designed. It still returned the whole CLOSING LINE, so "System.cmd(...) ; File.regular?(@fraud)" — a token named after the closing paren, on the call's own line — still read as argument-list membership: bound, never executed, THROUGH with a price. One line of the old window living inside the new predicate, past a 13-arm green selftest. THE RULE: when you replace a window with a boundary, the boundary is where the window's last residue hides — test the token that sits just OUTSIDE the new edge, not only the ones that sat inside the old one. PDS-D665 — BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER APPLIES TO EVIDENCE STRINGS, NOT ONLY TO DECLARED PATH SETS. The wish states the both-legs law for the hetzner slice's ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry. It bit somewhere nobody named: the sweep's own fix makes --selftest rc=0, which turns the door census row whose evidence quotes "--selftest rc=1" into a stale receipt the moment it merges — on the instrument whose entire subject is receipts that lie. The builder was fenced out of the census and correctly recorded the correction in two durable venues rather than reaching across the fence. Review co-landed the one-line row edit on the SAME branch: a behaviour and the receipt describing it merge together or not at all. A fence that splits those two has to be closed by whoever holds both, and the fix belongs on the branch that causes the drift. LEDGER AUDIT — three fixes, and one defect the audit itself surfaced Every slice task was claimed before work, stamped mid-claim with real evidence rather than batched at the end, and left in_progress with only the merge-gated row open — with one exception, now fixed. Tasks outside this wave were not touched. pds-w45-criterion-venue sat at lifecycle_status=open while HOLDING a live claim with 7 criteria stamped — a worked, claimed row reading as unstarted on every board. Re-claimed as the reviewer (epoch 9) so the lifecycle matches reality: in_progress, 8/9 met. pds-w45-criterion-venue[4] ("The lead-owned merge-gated row ... is EXPLICITLY EXEMPTED and is left byte-identical") was PROVEN but UNSTAMPED: bp task stamp refuses any --criterion-text containing the substring "merge-gated", so a row that DESCRIBES the gated row is refused as though it WERE one. Re-derived independently (cmp on the two lines: IDENTICAL, 189 bytes; full-file diff one hunk 137a138) and stamped with the override, with that provenance in the evidence. pds-w45-census-row-check-evidence — filed by the sweep builder as follow-up work — was DONE by the reviewer commit on the sweep branch. Claimed, its single criterion stamped with the new row verbatim plus four runs, and left in_progress: it closes when #9441 merges. The stamp-guard defect is NOT newly filed: it duplicates pds-w27-bl-stamp-guard-substring-false-positive (wave 27, still open, root-caused to internal/cli/tasks_stamp_cmd.go). A new task was created, the server flagged the duplicate, and it was DELETED rather than left to double-count the backlog. The recurrence is recorded here instead. Three follow-ups filed BY THE BUILDERS are published children of the epic and honest: pds-w45-argspan-sigil-and-silent-bound (sigil-blind blanking, the silent 40-line bound), task-ac55ff2388510d67 (the ladder's :stale arm is a NO-OP and nothing proves it), pds-w45-census-row-check-evidence (above). GRADE — A WHAT EARNS IT. The wave paid all three items the wish named and paid them in the order the dependencies allow. The second-review debt on #9377 is now discharged BY THE MERGING ARTIFACT rather than by a reviewer's hand mutation — that was the live gap on merged code, and it is the difference between "someone proved it once" and "the repo proves it every run". The ladder slice is the wave's best work: it recognised that its own headline number is evidence of nothing, said so in the printed output, and shipped the only discriminator that exists as a selftest case verified in both directions. The sweep slice reproduced its fail-open with the CORRECT oracle after the criterion named the wrong one, and closed it with the discriminator that was already on the wire. Four of five slices refuted something in their own dispatch by run — the eleventh, twelfth and thirteenth consecutive refutations — and each wrote the correction into the artifact instead of quietly satisfying a figure that does not exist. WHAT KEEPS IT OFF A+. Two of the five needed a reviewer fix to a predicate that had just been tightened, and in both cases the defect was one step past where the builder stopped looking: the first occurrence rather than the only occurrence, the closing line rather than the closing paren. Both slices had green, honest, non-vacuous selftests through the defect. The wave also left three real UNPROVEN arms shipping green by print rather than by mutation — the ladder's :stale filter, arg_span's "every call opening on the line" clause, and its 40-line bound — each filed, none closed, and each is exactly the shape this epic exists to refuse. And every price and timing in this wave is LOCAL: no PDS door has yet run on a foreign runner, so the price column remains an instrument calibrated against one host. NOT A CRITICISM, ON THE RECORD: the wish's item 4 (the unbuilt "?" variable-bound decline) was RULED OUT with a reason, not quietly dropped — PDS-D661 — and the ladder slice printed declined_live=0 as a BOUND on the sentence instead, derived THROUGH lvs_joinable?/1 so the number cannot drift from the predicate it describes. Ruling it out was the right half of "finish it or rule it out". WHAT THE NEXT WAVE TAKES MERGE ORDER FIRST. The five round-1 PRs are file-disjoint except that #9434 and #9441 both touch scripts/pds-door-census.sh — #9434 in the classifier and the selftest, #9441 at line 123 of PDS_DOOR_DISPOSITIONS only — so either order merges without a conflict. Then dispatch the deferred slices STRICTLY in dependency order, re-deriving every anchor at each merged base, because each one moves the file the next one reads. order slice dispatches after why the order is not negotiable 1 pds-w45-census-ledger-integrity #9434 merges Same file; the leg-A repair moves ~180 lines and every anchor in its brief is a line number. 2 pds-w45-price-provenance round 2 merges Built on top of the retire shape and the orphan check; the elided-key design assumes them. 3 pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door rounds 2 AND 3 merge It needs --measure to add its price row and the retire shape to dispose the orphaned ENVIRONMENT row. BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER: the instrument AND its ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry, or it is #9290/#9292 a third time. THEN WAVE 46'S OWN WORK, in the order the census's printed output ranks it: adjudicate the sweep's 59 unresolved-claim arrivals (the vocabulary is mined from the charter and THIS wave's charter PR moved it again, which is precisely why it could not be done here); price the receipt census's UNMEASURED-LOCAL expensive arm; and either justify or tier pds-ledger-census_test.sh at 40.33 s CPU on a 2-4 vCPU runner rather than shrugging at it. One standing debt outranks all of them for credibility: NO pds door has ever been measured on a foreign runner, so every figure in the price column is a loaded local mac. THE SECOND-REVIEWER DEBT, NAMED RATHER THAN ASSUMED DISCHARGED. #9433 is a HIGH-FLIP-RISK slice on a live grant/tenancy door, and this workflow spawns exactly ONE reviewer — so the independent second pass is a MANUAL LEAD STEP before merge. I re-derived the substitution from source and mutation-proved my own guard, but a genuinely independent pair of eyes on the authorization judgment is still owed. Every PR here also carries an open MERGE-GATED criterion that is the lead's to close on merge: #9433[8], #9434[10], #9438[14], #9441[9], #9442[8].

320.bodyText: PDS wave 45 - the price column learns to expire STRATEGIZE COMPLETE - the survey fleet is flying. GROUND TRUTH, DERIVED IN-PROCESS at origin/main ab8c86b05 in a detached worktree, never the primary checkout (which is stale at a31faa52d and dirty across eight charters). I ran scripts/pds-door-census.sh myself: rc=0, ERRORS 0, every program disposed. THE HEADLINE THE WISH DID NOT ASK FOR: the census runs in 4.13 s wall / 2.80 s CPU - so it CANNOT have taken the 40.33 s CPU / 68.24 s wall figure it prints. Every price and every disposition-evidence string is a hardcoded literal in PDS_DOOR_PRICES (:146-149) and PDS_DOOR_DISPOSITIONS (:123-137). The CLASS column became an instrument in wave 44. The PRICE column became a shell variable with a date stamp. And the denominator is 20 with 4 doors, not the 19 with 3 that both the wish and the lead notes carry - the census counts itself, and says so at :12-14. What I ran, and what it refuted Eleven consecutive waves have refuted their own dispatch from the artifact. This is the twelfth, and the refutations are load-bearing rather than cosmetic - three of the five figures the brief and the lead notes hand down are contradicted by the instrument on merged main. PREMISE, AS HANDED DOWN RE-DERIVED AT AB8C86B05 CONSEQUENCE "the door count is 3 of 19, not an unmeasured N" (lead notes, emphatic) THE COLUMN prints population 20 (18 .sh + 2 .exs), THROUGH 4 of 20 - pds-door-census.sh, pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs, pds-record-parity.test.sh, pds-status-only-residue.exs The census entered its own denominator by design (:12-14: "a census that hid itself would be the first thing it exists to catch"). 3-of-19 was true before #9380 merged. Do not quote it. "prints a class + a MEASURED PRICE or a named blocker with file:line" (wish item, the wave's whole claim) HALF TRUE. Class is computed: leg A is three mechanical predicates over the tree, leg B is evaluated by EXECUTING elixir-path-escape-check.sh. Price is a string literal. Timed: real 4,13 / user 0,81 / sys 1,99 for the entire run. THE WAVE'S SPINE. A 4-second program cannot have measured a 68-second row. "my 'exactly three refusal reasons' is FIVE by run plus a sixth (HUMAN-GATE)" The VOCABULARY is six (:105-115). The classes actually USED by a row on main are five: ENVIRONMENT (11), PRICE (2), CONTENT-RED (1), RED-BY-DESIGN-REPORTER (1), NOT-YET-BUILT (1). HUMAN-GATE is used by ZERO rows. The correction is right in direction and still not the run's number. A vocabulary entry no row exercises is itself an untested arm. "pds-live-hetzner-placement-group.sh - ENVIRONMENT, needs HCLOUD_TOKEN" (shipped disposition, :128) The CLASS is defensible; the EVIDENCE is about the wrong arm. It cites `--selftest` rc=3. The script's own header at :12-13 and :964 declares `--selftest-offline` "the CREDENTIAL-FREE arm and the CI-able gate". I ran it: rc=0, CPU 1.06+1.09 = 2.15 s at load1 15.44. A LIVE FALSEHOOD-BY-OMISSION in the shipped instrument, and the second-cheapest arm in the whole inventory sitting behind it. "pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh is CONTENT-RED, rc=1 today" (wish item 3) Confirmed as printed - but the census does not RUN it. The string "by run 2026-08-03 ... rc=1" is a literal at :123. The wish's own slice 3 takes this row to rc=0. The census will keep printing CONTENT-RED. The three blind spots, and why two of them are this wave's own doing The census has exactly one rot check, at :585-602, and it tests EXISTENCE: a ledger row naming a file that is no longer on disk is an error. That catches deletion. It cannot catch the three shapes that actually rot a price column. STALE PRICE. No content hash, no date arithmetic, no re-measurement. pds-record-parity.test.sh will print CPU=4.45s after someone doubles the harness's work, forever, and nothing reds. STALE DISPOSITION EVIDENCE. Five rows cite "by run 2026-08-03: <cmd> rc=N". The census never re-takes any of them. A disposition survives its own repair. ORPHANED DISPOSITION. Read the cond at :519-540: legA=yes AND legB=true short-circuits to THROUGH and the ledger is NEVER consulted. A disposition row for a now-THROUGH instrument is silently unread - not an error, not a warning, not printed. THE COUPLING THAT MAKES THIS THE SPINE RATHER THAN A TANGENT: two of the three deferred slices the wish orders will make the census lie the day they land. pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door puts --selftest-offline through a rider plus ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS - legA/legB then compute THROUGH and the ENVIRONMENT row at :128 becomes an unflagged orphan asserting a refusal that is no longer the disposition. pds-w44-charter-sweep-adjudication takes the sweep from rc=1 to rc=0 - and CONTENT-RED, evidenced by a run nobody re-takes, outlives the red it names. Price provenance is a PREREQUISITE for the wish's own item 2, not an addition to it. The direction The epic's law has walked one rung per wave. A receipt lies when the value it emits does not descend from the write return. A class lies when it does not descend from its substitution (wave 42). A gate lies when its green costs nothing to produce (wave 43). Wave 45's sentence is the one the new instrument earns: A PRICE LIES WHEN IT DOES NOT DESCEND FROM A METER THE INSTRUMENT ITSELF DROVE - AND A DISPOSITION LIES WHEN ITS EVIDENCE NAMES A RUN THE INSTRUMENT NEVER RE-TAKES. What the finished wave looks like: ./scripts/pds-door-census.sh still exits 0 on main and still costs seconds - it is a door, and its own 3.32 s row is its own gate cost, so any design that prices it out of its own door is disqualified before it is written. But every number it prints is now either taken by a meter it drove in THIS run, or a cached measurement carrying the content hash of the instrument it prices, so that a changed instrument turns the row PRICE-STALE and reds. A --measure verb takes the measurement and emits the exact ledger row, so re-pricing is one command rather than a hand ritual - the number descends from a meter the instrument drove, and anyone can re-take it. Dispositions whose evidence is a RUN get re-run under an opt-in, threshold-printed tier, so CONTENT-RED cannot survive its own repair. And an orphaned ledger row is an ERROR, because that is the exact shape both of this wave's own slices create. Around that spine, the debts get paid at the new base. Priority order, and the reasoning behind it: # WHAT WHY IT SITS HERE 1 #9377's SHIPPED non-vacuity test is a stub - make it real, then review The only item on this list that is a LIVE GAP ON MERGED CODE. Wave 44's reviewer re-proved the narrowing by hand-mutation; the merging artifact cannot reproduce that proof. A security fix whose non-vacuity cannot be re-run is a stamped receipt that overstates. This outranks the spine on urgency, not on scope. 2 Price provenance, expiry, and orphan detection in pds-door-census.sh The spine. Unblocks slices 4 and 5 from corrupting the instrument. 3 #9380's genuinely independent second review - 37 KB of shell, one pair of eyes D649 declared leg A's three predicates HIGH-FLIP-RISK and named the comment mutation as the oracle. It never got its builder's own review dispatch. 4 pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door - BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER, plus its census row I measured the arm today: rc=0, 2.15 s CPU. The cheapest unclaimed door in the inventory. It also carries the wave's sharpest overlap risk. 5 pds-w44-charter-sweep-adjudication - 45 rulings, and the fail-open at :203 Vocabulary is mined from the charter, which has now landed - and wave 44's own wave-log entry moved it again. Its bp_json(allow_error=True) fail-open is this epic's law broken inside the instrument that enforces it. 6 pds-w44-judgment-coverage-ladder at the new base #9378 shifted every line number. PROVEN-BACKED must be ONE Enum.count over ONE MapSet.union, taken once, never leg_a + leg_b. Its numbers have been dead three times. 7 lv_verdict/5's '?' variable-bound decline - finish properly or rule out with a reason Wave 44 recorded a non-build rather than shipping a cond reorder it could not justify. That was correct. It is still owed a disposition. 8 The criterion-venue rubric fix Cheap, and it prevents a whole class of unmeetable criteria: name the CLAIM, accept any durable venue. The direction debate Three directions were developed far enough to cost something, then argued against each other. Rival A - pay the debts, period Do exactly the wish's items 1 through 5: three deferred slices, two owed reviews, the lv_verdict half, the criterion lesson. Do not touch the census - it exits 0, wave 44 declared it done, and reopening it is a fifth wave of arguing about a column. This is the disciplined reading of the brief and it has a real claim on the wave. WHY IT LOSES: it hands the wave a false floor. Two of its own three slices silently corrupt the instrument, so "pay the debts" manufactures the next wave's finding. And it violates the mandate the user restates every single wave - DERIVE, NEVER TRANSCRIBE, INCLUDING FROM THIS BRIEF - by inheriting "the price column is an instrument now" as a premise instead of running it. I ran it. It is half an instrument, and the half that is prose is the half the column is named after. Rival B - measure every price, every run The pure fix: no cache, no ledger, no staleness possible. The census drives the meter for every row on every invocation and the price column is a measurement by construction. WHY IT LOSES, on the epic's own evidence: D648 proved wall is not a property of a door on a shared host - a fixed workload's wall spanned 5.8x at constant load while its user CPU spanned 27 percent. A re-measuring census becomes the most expensive program in its own denominator: 40.33 s for pds-ledger-census_test.sh alone, plus the receipt census whose expensive arm D646 showed conceals ~140 s minimum from any outer meter. It would also have to price ITSELF - a fixpoint. Worst of all it converts a 4 s door into an ungateable one, killing the census's own THROUGH row, which is the single most self-defeating outcome available to this wave. The honest design is not "always measure" but "never assert a measurement you cannot re-take, and know when it expired." Rival C - spend the column, gate the cheap doors Take the census output at face value and do the obvious thing the wish's title demands - SPEND IT. Put every affordable row through the required gate: hetzner offline at 2.15 s, pds-record-parity.test.sh at 4.45 s, pds-scratch-target_test.sh at 8.91 s. Maximum visible progress, and it is exactly what four waves of arguing were FOR. WHY IT LOSES AS A WHOLE DIRECTION, and why it is absorbed as a part: gating on unverified prices is D633's sin at one remove. pds-scratch-target_test.sh's own shipped row says "Hermeticity on a runner WITHOUT local Postgres is unproven here" - gating it is a day-one red on a foreign runner, the identical trap wave 44 documented for sheet-grid-js.yml. Rival C survives as exactly ONE new door: the one whose price and green I measured myself today. Why the winner won The spine plus the debts, with hetzner-offline as the one new door, is the only direction in which the wish's own item 2 does not manufacture the next wave's finding. It applies the epic's law to the epic's newest artifact, which is what every wave of this epic has actually been about. And it converts "spend the column" from a slogan into something that is safe to do more than once. The sharpest attack on the winner, and how the wave absorbs it THE ATTACK: "You are reopening a slice that shipped 11/12 with run evidence and rc=0 on main, on a distinction - 'measured' versus 'cached with provenance' - that is philosophy, not a defect. Nobody is harmed by a three-day-old CPU figure. This is the fifth consecutive wave arguing about a column, which is precisely what wave 44 ended." That attack has real force, and the wave absorbs it by refusing to argue and making it a RUN. The spine ships only if the verify round can demonstrate, by mutation against a real tree, a case where the shipped census prints a number or a class the tree contradicts. I already hold one candidate - the hetzner row's wrong-arm evidence - and this wave's own slices manufacture two more. IF THE VERIFIERS CANNOT MAKE THE SHIPPED CENSUS PRINT A FALSEHOOD AGAINST A REAL TREE, THE SPINE IS CUT AND THIS WAVE BECOMES RIVAL A. That is the fail-before condition, declared before the fleet flies, and it is the honest version of "derive, never transcribe" turned on my own direction. Second-order absorption, as a criterion rather than a hope: the design must not balloon the census's own price. A content hash per row is one shasum across 20 files - milliseconds. Re-running cheap dispositions is opt-in and threshold-printed, never on --check's default path. Standing hazards this wave carries THE FORMATTER VERSION TRAP, newly measured in wave 44: CI pins Elixir 1.18.1; this host runs 1.19.5. #9380 reddened Format while mix format --check-formatted exited 0 locally on the SAME commit. Apply CI's own suggested output verbatim and verify BOTH formatters accept it, or the red only moves. OVERLAP RISK, declared: #9380 now owns scripts/elixir-path-escape-check.sh and the hetzner slice edits the same declared set. Cloud Console wave 28 runs concurrently and owns .github/workflows/**. Coordinate before touching either. BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER on the hetzner slice - the instrument AND its ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry, or it is wave 42's #9290/#9292 a third time. The primary checkout is stale at a31faa52d and dirty across eight charter files. Read the charter via git show origin/main:<path>; build in worktrees only. A slice PR citing a D-number must not merge before the charter PR that defines it - the D643 rule, bought at the cost of 13 shipped citations pointing at decisions main did not define. PUSH EARLY AND OPEN THE PR ON THE FIRST GREEN COMMIT. Wave 43 lost four branches because nothing was pushed until review, and review never ran. The survey plan Fifteen Opus surveyors at medium effort. Width now buys precision later: every load-bearing assumption in the direction above is a question below, and the first three are aimed squarely at the spine's own fail-before condition. KEY QUESTION WHY IT CHANGES THE PLAN price-provenance-audit Re-derive independently whether pds-door-census.sh MEASURES or QUOTES its prices. Time the full run; trace every value in THE COLUMN back to either a computation or a literal at scripts/pds-door-census.sh:123-149. Which columns are computed, which are quoted? This is the wave's spine. If any price is genuinely re-measured the direction narrows sharply. census-rot-mutation Mutation-prove the three claimed blind spots against a real tree: (a) change a priced instrument's bytes and show the price still prints; (b) repair a CONTENT-RED row's cause and show CONTENT-RED still prints; (c) make a disposed instrument satisfy legA+legB and show its disposition row goes silently unread. Which actually fire? THE FAIL-BEFORE. If none of the three can be made to print a falsehood, the spine is CUT. hetzner-offline-door Verify --selftest-offline is genuinely credential-free and hermetic (env -i, no network, no HCLOUD_*), re-measure its CPU, and map EXACTLY what the rider plus ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry must contain. What does the census then print for that row, and does the ENVIRONMENT disposition become an orphan? Door number five and the live orphan demonstration in one slice. 9377-stub-nonvacuity Read api/test/barkpark_web/live/studio/pds_w44_grant_door_test.exs in full. Which case is the non-vacuity or mutation proof, and is it a stub? What would a REAL one assert, and does shared/paper.ex's narrowing survive an independent re-derivation from source? A live gap on merged security code - the highest-urgency item in the wave. 9380-independent-review Genuinely independent review of pds-door-census.sh's leg A: do the three predicates admit a fraudulent THROUGH? Run D649's comment mutation as the oracle. Also audit the --selftest fixture tree and whether the E1-E4 execution encodings are all covered. The second owed review; D649 declared it HIGH-FLIP-RISK. charter-sweep-adjudication Map scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh and pds-charter-ledger-adjudication.md: how many unresolved-claim arrivals against the CURRENT charter blob (D652 said 45), what the adjudication row format is, and the exact shape of the fail-open at :203 with bp_json allow_error=True. Slice five's scope and its own law-breach; the count moved once already. judgment-coverage-ladder Re-derive the ladder's anchors in scripts/pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs at the post-#9378 base. Where does PROVEN-BACKED belong, what are leg A and leg B, and why is the disposition sum near :4033 NOT a safe model for it? Slice six. Its numbers have been dead three times; every line number shifted. lv-verdict-unresolved-arm Read lv_verdict/5 at census.exs:4766 and lv_chain_verdict. Is the '?' variable-bound decline reachable through the residual? Wave 44 confirmed from source that the arm ordering does not admit the specified reorder - is there a semantically-honest route, or is the right answer a recorded rule-out? Item four. Finish properly or rule out with a reason - both are acceptable outcomes. receipt-census-unmeasured pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs is THROUGH but UNMEASURED-LOCAL. What IS the gated arm's real price (the rider, not --selftest), and can it be measured without hitting D646's fan-out blindness? Wish item three's first honest gap; determines whether a price is even obtainable. ledger-census-tiering Justify or refuse pds-ledger-census_test.sh at 40.33 s CPU and 68.24 s wall on a 2-4 vCPU runner. Re-measure. What are its 144 checks, is it decomposable into a cheap arm and an expensive one, and is the D647 figure reproducible? Wish item three's second gap; a shrug is explicitly not acceptable. scratch-target-hermeticity pds-scratch-target_test.sh is PRICE at 8.91 s with hermeticity unproven without local Postgres. Prove or refute hermeticity on a Postgres-free environment. Is it a further candidate door or a genuine PRICE refusal? The third PRICE row, unexamined by the brief - either a cheap win or a documented refusal. gate-plumbing-and-formatter Map elixir.yml's required legs, ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS and ELIXIR_COMPILE_PATHS semantics, and reproduce the 1.18.1-vs-1.19.5 formatter divergence. What is the exact procedure that satisfies BOTH formatters? Every slice touching a rider crosses this; wave 44 lost time to it twice. prior-art-sweep Search bp papers and tasks, and the epic tree under task-2ac1f95237c4a8e5, for prior art on price staleness, ledger expiry, content-hash freshness, and orphaned allowlist rows - anywhere in this repo, not only PDS. Has any of this been built and stranded? D645's lesson: git-based greps structurally cannot see stranded work. Check the ledger too. criterion-venue-rubric Find where slice criteria are authored (the cycle skill, the task-authoring rubric, prior wave criteria). Which shipped criteria presume a PR body, a push, or any workflow the builders do not have? Propose the venue-neutral phrasing. Item five - and it is cheap to build in only if the authoring surface is actually locatable. concurrency-and-fences What is actually in flight right now - open PRs, foreign claims on the epic tree, live worktrees, and Cloud Console wave 28's fence?
