reflow200.bodyText: PDS wave 45 - the price column learns to expire STRATEGIZE COMPLETE - the survey fleet is flying. GROUND TRUTH, DERIVED IN-PROCESS at origin/main ab8c86b05 in a detached worktree, never the primary checkout (which is stale at a31faa52d and dirty across eight charters). I ran scripts/pds-door-census.sh myself: rc=0, ERRORS 0, every program disposed. THE HEADLINE THE WISH DID NOT ASK FOR: the census runs in 4.13 s wall / 2.80 s CPU - so it CANNOT have taken the 40.33 s CPU / 68.24 s wall figure it prints. Every price and every disposition-evidence string is a hardcoded literal in PDS_DOOR_PRICES (:146-149) and PDS_DOOR_DISPOSITIONS (:123-137). The CLASS column became an instrument in wave 44. The PRICE column became a shell variable with a date stamp. And the denominator is 20 with 4 doors, not the 19 with 3 that both the wish and the lead notes carry - the census counts itself, and says so at :12-14. What I ran, and what it refuted Eleven consecutive waves have refuted their own dispatch from the artifact. This is the twelfth, and the refutations are load-bearing rather than cosmetic - three of the five figures the brief and the lead notes hand down are contradicted by the instrument on merged main. PREMISE, AS HANDED DOWN RE-DERIVED AT AB8C86B05 CONSEQUENCE "the door count is 3 of 19, not an unmeasured N" (lead notes, emphatic) THE COLUMN prints population 20 (18 .sh + 2 .exs), THROUGH 4 of 20 - pds-door-census.sh, pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs, pds-record-parity.test.sh, pds-status-only-residue.exs The census entered its own denominator by design (:12-14: "a census that hid itself would be the first thing it exists to catch"). 3-of-19 was true before #9380 merged. Do not quote it. "prints a class + a MEASURED PRICE or a named blocker with file:line" (wish item, the wave's whole claim) HALF TRUE. Class is computed: leg A is three mechanical predicates over the tree, leg B is evaluated by EXECUTING elixir-path-escape-check.sh. Price is a string literal. Timed: real 4,13 / user 0,81 / sys 1,99 for the entire run. THE WAVE'S SPINE. A 4-second program cannot have measured a 68-second row. "my 'exactly three refusal reasons' is FIVE by run plus a sixth (HUMAN-GATE)" The VOCABULARY is six (:105-115). The classes actually USED by a row on main are five: ENVIRONMENT (11), PRICE (2), CONTENT-RED (1), RED-BY-DESIGN-REPORTER (1), NOT-YET-BUILT (1). HUMAN-GATE is used by ZERO rows. The correction is right in direction and still not the run's number. A vocabulary entry no row exercises is itself an untested arm. "pds-live-hetzner-placement-group.sh - ENVIRONMENT, needs HCLOUD_TOKEN" (shipped disposition, :128) The CLASS is defensible; the EVIDENCE is about the wrong arm. It cites `--selftest` rc=3. The script's own header at :12-13 and :964 declares `--selftest-offline` "the CREDENTIAL-FREE arm and the CI-able gate". I ran it: rc=0, CPU 1.06+1.09 = 2.15 s at load1 15.44. A LIVE FALSEHOOD-BY-OMISSION in the shipped instrument, and the second-cheapest arm in the whole inventory sitting behind it. "pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh is CONTENT-RED, rc=1 today" (wish item 3) Confirmed as printed - but the census does not RUN it. The string "by run 2026-08-03 ... rc=1" is a literal at :123. The wish's own slice 3 takes this row to rc=0. The census will keep printing CONTENT-RED. The three blind spots, and why two of them are this wave's own doing The census has exactly one rot check, at :585-602, and it tests EXISTENCE: a ledger row naming a file that is no longer on disk is an error. That catches deletion. It cannot catch the three shapes that actually rot a price column. STALE PRICE. No content hash, no date arithmetic, no re-measurement. pds-record-parity.test.sh will print CPU=4.45s after someone doubles the harness's work, forever, and nothing reds. STALE DISPOSITION EVIDENCE. Five rows cite "by run 2026-08-03: <cmd> rc=N". The census never re-takes any of them. A disposition survives its own repair. ORPHANED DISPOSITION. Read the cond at :519-540: legA=yes AND legB=true short-circuits to THROUGH and the ledger is NEVER consulted. A disposition row for a now-THROUGH instrument is silently unread - not an error, not a warning, not printed. THE COUPLING THAT MAKES THIS THE SPINE RATHER THAN A TANGENT: two of the three deferred slices the wish orders will make the census lie the day they land. pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door puts --selftest-offline through a rider plus ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS - legA/legB then compute THROUGH and the ENVIRONMENT row at :128 becomes an unflagged orphan asserting a refusal that is no longer the disposition. pds-w44-charter-sweep-adjudication takes the sweep from rc=1 to rc=0 - and CONTENT-RED, evidenced by a run nobody re-takes, outlives the red it names. Price provenance is a PREREQUISITE for the wish's own item 2, not an addition to it. The direction The epic's law has walked one rung per wave. A receipt lies when the value it emits does not descend from the write return. A class lies when it does not descend from its substitution (wave 42). A gate lies when its green costs nothing to produce (wave 43). Wave 45's sentence is the one the new instrument earns: A PRICE LIES WHEN IT DOES NOT DESCEND FROM A METER THE INSTRUMENT ITSELF DROVE - AND A DISPOSITION LIES WHEN ITS EVIDENCE NAMES A RUN THE INSTRUMENT NEVER RE-TAKES. What the finished wave looks like: ./scripts/pds-door-census.sh still exits 0 on main and still costs seconds - it is a door, and its own 3.32 s row is its own gate cost, so any design that prices it out of its own door is disqualified before it is written. But every number it prints is now either taken by a meter it drove in THIS run, or a cached measurement carrying the content hash of the instrument it prices, so that a changed instrument turns the row PRICE-STALE and reds. A --measure verb takes the measurement and emits the exact ledger row, so re-pricing is one command rather than a hand ritual - the number descends from a meter the instrument drove, and anyone can re-take it. Dispositions whose evidence is a RUN get re-run under an opt-in, threshold-printed tier, so CONTENT-RED cannot survive its own repair. And an orphaned ledger row is an ERROR, because that is the exact shape both of this wave's own slices create. Around that spine, the debts get paid at the new base. Priority order, and the reasoning behind it: # WHAT WHY IT SITS HERE 1 #9377's SHIPPED non-vacuity test is a stub - make it real, then review The only item on this list that is a LIVE GAP ON MERGED CODE. Wave 44's reviewer re-proved the narrowing by hand-mutation; the merging artifact cannot reproduce that proof. A security fix whose non-vacuity cannot be re-run is a stamped receipt that overstates. This outranks the spine on urgency, not on scope. 2 Price provenance, expiry, and orphan detection in pds-door-census.sh The spine. Unblocks slices 4 and 5 from corrupting the instrument. 3 #9380's genuinely independent second review - 37 KB of shell, one pair of eyes D649 declared leg A's three predicates HIGH-FLIP-RISK and named the comment mutation as the oracle. It never got its builder's own review dispatch. 4 pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door - BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER, plus its census row I measured the arm today: rc=0, 2.15 s CPU. The cheapest unclaimed door in the inventory. It also carries the wave's sharpest overlap risk. 5 pds-w44-charter-sweep-adjudication - 45 rulings, and the fail-open at :203 Vocabulary is mined from the charter, which has now landed - and wave 44's own wave-log entry moved it again. Its bp_json(allow_error=True) fail-open is this epic's law broken inside the instrument that enforces it. 6 pds-w44-judgment-coverage-ladder at the new base #9378 shifted every line number. PROVEN-BACKED must be ONE Enum.count over ONE MapSet.union, taken once, never leg_a + leg_b. Its numbers have been dead three times. 7 lv_verdict/5's '?' variable-bound decline - finish properly or rule out with a reason Wave 44 recorded a non-build rather than shipping a cond reorder it could not justify. That was correct. It is still owed a disposition. 8 The criterion-venue rubric fix Cheap, and it prevents a whole class of unmeetable criteria: name the CLAIM, accept any durable venue. The direction debate Three directions were developed far enough to cost something, then argued against each other. Rival A - pay the debts, period Do exactly the wish's items 1 through 5: three deferred slices, two owed reviews, the lv_verdict half, the criterion lesson. Do not touch the census - it exits 0, wave 44 declared it done, and reopening it is a fifth wave of arguing about a column. This is the disciplined reading of the brief and it has a real claim on the wave. WHY IT LOSES: it hands the wave a false floor. Two of its own three slices silently corrupt the instrument, so "pay the debts" manufactures the next wave's finding. And it violates the mandate the user restates every single wave - DERIVE, NEVER TRANSCRIBE, INCLUDING FROM THIS BRIEF - by inheriting "the price column is an instrument now" as a premise instead of running it. I ran it. It is half an instrument, and the half that is prose is the half the column is named after. Rival B - measure every price, every run The pure fix: no cache, no ledger, no staleness possible. The census drives the meter for every row on every invocation and the price column is a measurement by construction. WHY IT LOSES, on the epic's own evidence: D648 proved wall is not a property of a door on a shared host - a fixed workload's wall spanned 5.8x at constant load while its user CPU spanned 27 percent. A re-measuring census becomes the most expensive program in its own denominator: 40.33 s for pds-ledger-census_test.sh alone, plus the receipt census whose expensive arm D646 showed conceals ~140 s minimum from any outer meter. It would also have to price ITSELF - a fixpoint. Worst of all it converts a 4 s door into an ungateable one, killing the census's own THROUGH row, which is the single most self-defeating outcome available to this wave. The honest design is not "always measure" but "never assert a measurement you cannot re-take, and know when it expired." Rival C - spend the column, gate the cheap doors Take the census output at face value and do the obvious thing the wish's title demands - SPEND IT. Put every affordable row through the required gate: hetzner offline at 2.15 s, pds-record-parity.test.sh at 4.45 s, pds-scratch-target_test.sh at 8.91 s. Maximum visible progress, and it is exactly what four waves of arguing were FOR. WHY IT LOSES AS A WHOLE DIRECTION, and why it is absorbed as a part: gating on unverified prices is D633's sin at one remove. pds-scratch-target_test.sh's own shipped row says "Hermeticity on a runner WITHOUT local Postgres is unproven here" - gating it is a day-one red on a foreign runner, the identical trap wave 44 documented for sheet-grid-js.yml. Rival C survives as exactly ONE new door: the one whose price and green I measured myself today. Why the winner won The spine plus the debts, with hetzner-offline as the one new door, is the only direction in which the wish's own item 2 does not manufacture the next wave's finding. It applies the epic's law to the epic's newest artifact, which is what every wave of this epic has actually been about. And it converts "spend the column" from a slogan into something that is safe to do more than once. The sharpest attack on the winner, and how the wave absorbs it THE ATTACK: "You are reopening a slice that shipped 11/12 with run evidence and rc=0 on main, on a distinction - 'measured' versus 'cached with provenance' - that is philosophy, not a defect. Nobody is harmed by a three-day-old CPU figure. This is the fifth consecutive wave arguing about a column, which is precisely what wave 44 ended." That attack has real force, and the wave absorbs it by refusing to argue and making it a RUN. The spine ships only if the verify round can demonstrate, by mutation against a real tree, a case where the shipped census prints a number or a class the tree contradicts. I already hold one candidate - the hetzner row's wrong-arm evidence - and this wave's own slices manufacture two more. IF THE VERIFIERS CANNOT MAKE THE SHIPPED CENSUS PRINT A FALSEHOOD AGAINST A REAL TREE, THE SPINE IS CUT AND THIS WAVE BECOMES RIVAL A. That is the fail-before condition, declared before the fleet flies, and it is the honest version of "derive, never transcribe" turned on my own direction. Second-order absorption, as a criterion rather than a hope: the design must not balloon the census's own price. A content hash per row is one shasum across 20 files - milliseconds. Re-running cheap dispositions is opt-in and threshold-printed, never on --check's default path. Standing hazards this wave carries THE FORMATTER VERSION TRAP, newly measured in wave 44: CI pins Elixir 1.18.1; this host runs 1.19.5. #9380 reddened Format while mix format --check-formatted exited 0 locally on the SAME commit. Apply CI's own suggested output verbatim and verify BOTH formatters accept it, or the red only moves. OVERLAP RISK, declared: #9380 now owns scripts/elixir-path-escape-check.sh and the hetzner slice edits the same declared set. Cloud Console wave 28 runs concurrently and owns .github/workflows/**. Coordinate before touching either. BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER on the hetzner slice - the instrument AND its ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry, or it is wave 42's #9290/#9292 a third time. The primary checkout is stale at a31faa52d and dirty across eight charter files. Read the charter via git show origin/main:<path>; build in worktrees only. A slice PR citing a D-number must not merge before the charter PR that defines it - the D643 rule, bought at the cost of 13 shipped citations pointing at decisions main did not define. PUSH EARLY AND OPEN THE PR ON THE FIRST GREEN COMMIT. Wave 43 lost four branches because nothing was pushed until review, and review never ran. The survey plan Fifteen Opus surveyors at medium effort. Width now buys precision later: every load-bearing assumption in the direction above is a question below, and the first three are aimed squarely at the spine's own fail-before condition. KEY QUESTION WHY IT CHANGES THE PLAN price-provenance-audit Re-derive independently whether pds-door-census.sh MEASURES or QUOTES its prices. Time the full run; trace every value in THE COLUMN back to either a computation or a literal at scripts/pds-door-census.sh:123-149. Which columns are computed, which are quoted? This is the wave's spine. If any price is genuinely re-measured the direction narrows sharply. census-rot-mutation Mutation-prove the three claimed blind spots against a real tree: (a) change a priced instrument's bytes and show the price still prints; (b) repair a CONTENT-RED row's cause and show CONTENT-RED still prints; (c) make a disposed instrument satisfy legA+legB and show its disposition row goes silently unread. Which actually fire? THE FAIL-BEFORE. If none of the three can be made to print a falsehood, the spine is CUT. hetzner-offline-door Verify --selftest-offline is genuinely credential-free and hermetic (env -i, no network, no HCLOUD_*), re-measure its CPU, and map EXACTLY what the rider plus ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry must contain. What does the census then print for that row, and does the ENVIRONMENT disposition become an orphan? Door number five and the live orphan demonstration in one slice. 9377-stub-nonvacuity Read api/test/barkpark_web/live/studio/pds_w44_grant_door_test.exs in full. Which case is the non-vacuity or mutation proof, and is it a stub? What would a REAL one assert, and does shared/paper.ex's narrowing survive an independent re-derivation from source? A live gap on merged security code - the highest-urgency item in the wave. 9380-independent-review Genuinely independent review of pds-door-census.sh's leg A: do the three predicates admit a fraudulent THROUGH? Run D649's comment mutation as the oracle. Also audit the --selftest fixture tree and whether the E1-E4 execution encodings are all covered. The second owed review; D649 declared it HIGH-FLIP-RISK. charter-sweep-adjudication Map scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh and pds-charter-ledger-adjudication.md: how many unresolved-claim arrivals against the CURRENT charter blob (D652 said 45), what the adjudication row format is, and the exact shape of the fail-open at :203 with bp_json allow_error=True. Slice five's scope and its own law-breach; the count moved once already. judgment-coverage-ladder Re-derive the ladder's anchors in scripts/pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs at the post-#9378 base. Where does PROVEN-BACKED belong, what are leg A and leg B, and why is the disposition sum near :4033 NOT a safe model for it? Slice six. Its numbers have been dead three times; every line number shifted. lv-verdict-unresolved-arm Read lv_verdict/5 at census.exs:4766 and lv_chain_verdict. Is the '?' variable-bound decline reachable through the residual? Wave 44 confirmed from source that the arm ordering does not admit the specified reorder - is there a semantically-honest route, or is the right answer a recorded rule-out? Item four. Finish properly or rule out with a reason - both are acceptable outcomes. receipt-census-unmeasured pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs is THROUGH but UNMEASURED-LOCAL. What IS the gated arm's real price (the rider, not --selftest), and can it be measured without hitting D646's fan-out blindness? The shipped block is a tautology plus a duplicate; the repair needs no api/lib byte, which is exactly what keeps it out of Console's declared fence. D658 Leg A must read the ARGUMENT LIST, not the neighbourhood. Three fraud shapes produce THROUGH with a price attached — and the window also DECLINES an honest five-line Port.open door, so the fix is not 'decline more'. D659 Six rot classes; an orphaned disposition is an ERROR; retirement is the only escape hatch and requires the dupe check in the same slice. The rot check tests existence only, and the four rows that actually gate carry no price-shape check in the instrument OR its rider. D660 PROVEN-BACKED is ONE Enum.count over ONE MapSet.union, and the injection proof must SHIP. OVERLAP is 0, so the forbidden addition prints the right integer. Evidence quoting '23' proves nothing. D661 The '?' variable-bound decline is RULED OUT, with a source-derived reason. The reorder widens the residual by proxy (87/322, integrity arm still PASS) and the arm has no join key — lvs_joinable? drops the module name upstream. A recorded rule-out is the honest outcome. D662 Criterion venue is neutral, and evidence TYPE is too. gh pr create --body suppresses commit autofill, so a PR-body criterion is unmeetable the moment a builder finishes — a 57% loss rate on built work. D663 The sweep ADJUDICATION defers to wave 46; its FAIL-OPEN builds now. The vocabulary is mined from the charter in-process (41 -> 45 -> 59), so this wave's own charter PR moves it a fourth time. The fail-open is independent of all that. THE EPIC'S NEXT SENTENCE, earned by run: A PRICE LIES WHEN IT DOES NOT DESCEND FROM A METER THE INSTRUMENT ITSELF DROVE — AND A DISPOSITION LIES WHEN ITS EVIDENCE NAMES A RUN THE INSTRUMENT NEVER RE-TAKES. Sharpened by the measurements: A PRICE IS QUOTABLE ONLY AGAINST ITS OWN LOAD STAMP. THE WAVE PLAN — 8 slices, 5 in round 1 # slice round task id surface model gate 1 #9377's non-vacuity stops being a tautology over its own literal 1 pds-w45-grant-door-nonvacuity api/test/…/pds_w44_grant_door_test.exs ONLY opus cd api && CC=/usr/bin/clang mix test test/barkpark_web/live/studio/pds_w44_grant_door_test.exs 2 Leg A reads the ARGUMENT LIST; the enumerator stops dying silently 1 pds-w45-lega-argument-list scripts/pds-door-census.sh (awk + instruments + selftest) opus bash scripts/pds-door-census.sh --selftest ; --check ; shellcheck -S error ; mix test pds_door_census_test.exs 3 PROVEN-BACKED as a union, never an addition — and the '?' prose stops overclaiming 1 pds-w44-judgment-coverage-ladder pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs + docs/decisions/ opus elixir scripts/pds-elixir-receipt-census.exs ; --selftest ; bash scripts/check-doc-budgets.sh 4 The sweep's fail-open closes; its selftest stops being the corpus's hostage 1 pds-w45-sweep-failopen scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh opus bash scripts/pds-charter-ledger-sweep.sh --selftest 5 A criterion names the CLAIM, not the container 1 pds-w45-criterion-venue .claude/workflows/bp-epic-cycle.workflow.js opus node --check .claude/workflows/bp-epic-cycle.workflow.js 6 The ledger stops lying by silence: orphan, retire, dupe, THROUGH shape, evidenced UNMEASURED 2 (after 2) pds-w45-census-ledger-integrity scripts/pds-door-census.sh (cond + rot check + selftest) opus bash scripts/pds-door-census.sh --selftest ; --check ; shellcheck -S error ; mix test pds_door_census_test.exs 7 The price column learns to expire: content key, PRICE-STALE, --measure 3 (after 6) pds-w45-price-provenance scripts/pds-door-census.sh (key + verb) opus bash scripts/pds-door-census.sh --check ; --selftest ; --measure ; mix test pds_door_census_test.exs 8 The hetzner offline arm becomes door 5 of 20 — FIVE edits, THREE files 4 (after 6, 7) pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door rider + escape-check x2 + census ledger x2 opus bash scripts/elixir-path-escape-check.sh --selftest ; --match test ; pds-door-census.sh --check ; mix test HIGH-FLIP-RISK, declared. Slice 1 — whether a Code.compile_string substitution proves what a tautology did not, on a LIVE authorization door, and whether the repair stays out of api/lib and therefore out of Console's fence. Slice 2 — whether the argument-list predicate still admits a fraudulent THROUGH, and whether it now DECLINES an honest door; the fix must be proven in BOTH directions and the Port.open arm is the second-direction oracle. Slice 6 — whether the retire shape is a bypass, and whether the orphan check has a false-positive mode. All three warrant a genuinely INDEPENDENT second reviewer before merge; this workflow spawns one reviewer, so that dispatch is the lead's manual step. ROUNDS ARE LAW. Slices 6, 7 and 8 all edit scripts/pds-door-census.sh and are strictly sequenced behind slice 2 and each other. They do NOT build this run; the lead dispatches each after its dependency MERGES. A round-1 slice whose dependency is unmerged burns a builder to produce a BLOCKED report. FABLE WAS UNAVAILABLE. Every slice is built at opus@medium, including three (2, 6, 7) that are genuinely hard on the difficulty axis and would otherwise have gone to fable. That is a recorded constraint, not a judgment that these slices are routine. BACKLOG FILED — the future, not just the present task id what priority pds-w45-bl-sweep-adjudication-frozen-blob Adjudicate the sweep's 59 arrivals against a FROZEN BLOB SHA, never a count. 13 of them are a LENS repair, not judgment; bucket 'reflow' is empty. 1 pds-w45-bl-grant-door-untested-arms Three untested arms in the merged grant door (grant_graded?'s OR, write_target_scope's fail-closed, doc_field totality) plus a denial flash with TWO producers that cannot say which door refused. 1 pds-w45-bl-ledger-census-lazy-urllib The 144-check harness costs 144 interpreter boots, not 144 checks. Lazy urllib is 2 lines for -29% CPU, measured. Refuse the cheap-arm/expensive-arm split. 2 pds-w45-bl-scratch-target-class-refuted Its hermeticity refusal is REFUTED by run, and the remaining PRICE clause has no predicate — the census has no numeric threshold anywhere. 2 pds-w45-bl-receipt-census-self-claims The census misstates its own gating on merged code, and hand-types two numbers inside the very @blind_spot list D633 built to stop that. 2 pds-w45-bl-foreign-runner-first-door No pds door has ever run on a foreign CI runner. D648 already directs that CI overwrite the local figure; nothing ever has. 2 pds-w44-lv-verdict-unresolved-spec-arm SUPERSEDED by PDS-D661 and demoted to priority 4 — left open only as a tripwire for the day declined_live stops being 0. 4 A note on what this wave refused to do. Rival A — 'pay the debts, period' — would have shipped two of its own three slices into an instrument they silently corrupt: hetzner-offline manufactures the orphaned ENVIRONMENT row, and the sweep adjudication makes CONTENT-RED outlive its red. That is why the ledger-integrity slice is a PREREQUISITE for the wish's own item 2 and not a tangent. And the sharpest attack on the winner — that 'measured versus cached-with-provenance' is philosophy, not a defect — was answered not by argument but by a run: the shipped census prices a gutted two-line harness at 4.45 s and 76 checks, and its 40.33 s row is wrong by 40% today. DEBRIEF — what shipped, what it cost, and the grade Reviewed 2026-08-03 by the wave reviewer, in an isolated worktree, with every gate re-run on the FINAL branch rather than read from a builder report. Five of five round-1 slices are green and PUSHED with PRs open; three round-2+ slices were deferred by design and their tasks say so. Grade: A. WHAT SHIPPED — per slice, with the branch the lead should integrate. Three branches carry a reviewer commit on top of the builder commit; two are the builder branch unchanged, because the diff was correct as built and there was nothing honest to add. task final branch PR gate re-run on the final state verdict pds-w45-grant-door-nonvacuity loop-epic/9377-s-non-vacuity-stops-being-a-tautolo-0-r #9433 mix test pds_w44_grant_door_test.exs -> 5 tests, 0 failures; mix format --check-formatted rc=0 The tautology is gone and replaced by a real substitution on the SHIPPED module. REVIEWER FIX (c07e9fcb2): the guard was mutant != original, which proves only that SOMETHING was replaced; global: false takes the FIRST match, so it now pins the expression to EXACTLY ONE occurrence. Proven by mutation: an absent expression reds AT the new guard. pds-w45-lega-argument-list loop-epic/leg-a-reads-the-argument-list-not-the-ne-1-r #9434 selftest 14 PASS / 0 FAIL; --check rc=0 and BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-review baseline; shellcheck -S error rc=0; mix test pds_door_census_test.exs 8 tests, 0 failures Membership replaces proximity in both directions, and the enumerator stops dying silently. REVIEWER FIX (08a5b74ee): FRAUD D — the span balanced the parens but returned the WHOLE closing line, so a token named AFTER the closing paren still read as membership. Now cut to the paren column; the arm reds LEGA-BOUND-EXEC on revert. pds-w44-judgment-coverage-ladder loop-epic/proven-backed-as-a-union-never-an-additi-2 (unchanged) #9438 census rc=0; --selftest rc=0, 34 cases / 23 mutants incl. PASS LADDER-UNION-NOT-SUM; check-doc-budgets PASS The strongest slice of the wave. The number 23 is worthless as evidence (OVERLAP is 0), the builder knew it, and shipped the only thing that can discriminate — a count-free relation token, verified red in the other direction. The doc figures were re-derived from MY run, not the report: JUDGED 67, EXCLUDED 178, 74/252 = 29.4%, all match. pds-w45-sweep-failopen loop-epic/the-charter-sweep-s-fail-open-closes-and-3-r #9441 sweep --selftest rc=0 "SELFTEST OK: 3 of 3"; door census --check rc=0, --selftest 8/8, shellcheck rc=0 The fail-open is closed and I re-derived it INDEPENDENTLY: an expired-token shim over a pinned ledger snapshot now gives rc=2 UNCHECKED naming the slug, where before it was byte-identical to a healthy run. REVIEWER FIX (6c42cf3e6): the census row that describes this instrument co-lands, because the sweep fix alone makes that row a stale receipt. pds-w45-criterion-venue loop-epic/a-criterion-names-the-claim-not-the-cont-4 (unchanged) #9442 node --check rc=0 One additive bullet, epic-neutral, purely additive: full-file diff is one hunk 137a138, and the merge-gated row shifted 141 -> 142 byte-identical (cmp: 189 bytes, re-derived by me). Cheapest slice in the wave and it retroactively unblocks unstamped criteria on merged work. WHAT STALLED — nothing. Three slices were deferred by the sequenced-rounds law, each on a hard dependency that has to merge first: pds-w45-census-ledger-integrity (round 2, after #9434 — same file, ~180 lines move), pds-w45-price-provenance (round 3, after round 2 — same file, built on top), pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door (round 4, after both — it needs the retire shape and --measure those rounds create). Their tasks are open, unclaimed and 0/N met, which is the honest state, not a stall. THE TWO FINDINGS REVIEW ADDED, AND THE RULES THEY BUY PDS-D664 — A REPAIRED PREDICATE CARRIES ITS OLD DEFECT FOR EXACTLY ONE LINE. arg_span replaced the three-line proximity window with a real paren-balance walk, and the three fraud shapes flipped as designed. It still returned the whole CLOSING LINE, so "System.cmd(...) ; File.regular?(@fraud)" — a token named after the closing paren, on the call's own line — still read as argument-list membership: bound, never executed, THROUGH with a price. One line of the old window living inside the new predicate, past a 13-arm green selftest. THE RULE: when you replace a window with a boundary, the boundary is where the window's last residue hides — test the token that sits just OUTSIDE the new edge, not only the ones that sat inside the old one. PDS-D665 — BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER APPLIES TO EVIDENCE STRINGS, NOT ONLY TO DECLARED PATH SETS. The wish states the both-legs law for the hetzner slice's ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry. It bit somewhere nobody named: the sweep's own fix makes --selftest rc=0, which turns the door census row whose evidence quotes "--selftest rc=1" into a stale receipt the moment it merges — on the instrument whose entire subject is receipts that lie. The builder was fenced out of the census and correctly recorded the correction in two durable venues rather than reaching across the fence. Review co-landed the one-line row edit on the SAME branch: a behaviour and the receipt describing it merge together or not at all. A fence that splits those two has to be closed by whoever holds both, and the fix belongs on the branch that causes the drift. LEDGER AUDIT — three fixes, and one defect the audit itself surfaced Every slice task was claimed before work, stamped mid-claim with real evidence rather than batched at the end, and left in_progress with only the merge-gated row open — with one exception, now fixed. Tasks outside this wave were not touched. pds-w45-criterion-venue sat at lifecycle_status=open while HOLDING a live claim with 7 criteria stamped — a worked, claimed row reading as unstarted on every board. Re-claimed as the reviewer (epoch 9) so the lifecycle matches reality: in_progress, 8/9 met. pds-w45-criterion-venue[4] ("The lead-owned merge-gated row ... is EXPLICITLY EXEMPTED and is left byte-identical") was PROVEN but UNSTAMPED: bp task stamp refuses any --criterion-text containing the substring "merge-gated", so a row that DESCRIBES the gated row is refused as though it WERE one. Re-derived independently (cmp on the two lines: IDENTICAL, 189 bytes; full-file diff one hunk 137a138) and stamped with the override, with that provenance in the evidence. pds-w45-census-row-check-evidence — filed by the sweep builder as follow-up work — was DONE by the reviewer commit on the sweep branch. Claimed, its single criterion stamped with the new row verbatim plus four runs, and left in_progress: it closes when #9441 merges. The stamp-guard defect is NOT newly filed: it duplicates pds-w27-bl-stamp-guard-substring-false-positive (wave 27, still open, root-caused to internal/cli/tasks_stamp_cmd.go). A new task was created, the server flagged the duplicate, and it was DELETED rather than left to double-count the backlog. The recurrence is recorded here instead. Three follow-ups filed BY THE BUILDERS are published children of the epic and honest: pds-w45-argspan-sigil-and-silent-bound (sigil-blind blanking, the silent 40-line bound), task-ac55ff2388510d67 (the ladder's :stale arm is a NO-OP and nothing proves it), pds-w45-census-row-check-evidence (above). GRADE — A WHAT EARNS IT. The wave paid all three items the wish named and paid them in the order the dependencies allow. The second-review debt on #9377 is now discharged BY THE MERGING ARTIFACT rather than by a reviewer's hand mutation — that was the live gap on merged code, and it is the difference between "someone proved it once" and "the repo proves it every run". The ladder slice is the wave's best work: it recognised that its own headline number is evidence of nothing, said so in the printed output, and shipped the only discriminator that exists as a selftest case verified in both directions. The sweep slice reproduced its fail-open with the CORRECT oracle after the criterion named the wrong one, and closed it with the discriminator that was already on the wire. Four of five slices refuted something in their own dispatch by run — the eleventh, twelfth and thirteenth consecutive refutations — and each wrote the correction into the artifact instead of quietly satisfying a figure that does not exist. WHAT KEEPS IT OFF A+. Two of the five needed a reviewer fix to a predicate that had just been tightened, and in both cases the defect was one step past where the builder stopped looking: the first occurrence rather than the only occurrence, the closing line rather than the closing paren. Both slices had green, honest, non-vacuous selftests through the defect. The wave also left three real UNPROVEN arms shipping green by print rather than by mutation — the ladder's :stale filter, arg_span's "every call opening on the line" clause, and its 40-line bound — each filed, none closed, and each is exactly the shape this epic exists to refuse. And every price and timing in this wave is LOCAL: no PDS door has yet run on a foreign runner, so the price column remains an instrument calibrated against one host. NOT A CRITICISM, ON THE RECORD: the wish's item 4 (the unbuilt "?" variable-bound decline) was RULED OUT with a reason, not quietly dropped — PDS-D661 — and the ladder slice printed declined_live=0 as a BOUND on the sentence instead, derived THROUGH lvs_joinable?/1 so the number cannot drift from the predicate it describes. Ruling it out was the right half of "finish it or rule it out". WHAT THE NEXT WAVE TAKES MERGE ORDER FIRST. The five round-1 PRs are file-disjoint except that #9434 and #9441 both touch scripts/pds-door-census.sh — #9434 in the classifier and the selftest, #9441 at line 123 of PDS_DOOR_DISPOSITIONS only — so either order merges without a conflict. Then dispatch the deferred slices STRICTLY in dependency order, re-deriving every anchor at each merged base, because each one moves the file the next one reads. order slice dispatches after why the order is not negotiable 1 pds-w45-census-ledger-integrity #9434 merges Same file; the leg-A repair moves ~180 lines and every anchor in its brief is a line number. 2 pds-w45-price-provenance round 2 merges Built on top of the retire shape and the orphan check; the elided-key design assumes them. 3 pds-w44-hetzner-offline-door rounds 2 AND 3 merge It needs --measure to add its price row and the retire shape to dispose the orphaned ENVIRONMENT row. BOTH LEGS OR NEITHER: the instrument AND its ELIXIR_TEST_ONLY_PATHS entry, or it is #9290/#9292 a third time. THEN WAVE 46'S OWN WORK, in the order the census's printed output ranks it: adjudicate the sweep's 59 unresolved-claim arrivals (the vocabulary is mined from the charter and THIS wave's charter PR moved it again, which is precisely why it could not be done here); price the receipt census's UNMEASURED-LOCAL expensive arm; and either justify or tier pds-ledger-census_test.sh at 40.33 s CPU on a 2-4 vCPU runner rather than shrugging at it. One standing debt outranks all of them for credibility: NO pds door has ever been measured on a foreign runner, so every figure in the price column is a loaded local mac. THE SECOND-REVIEWER DEBT, NAMED RATHER THAN ASSUMED DISCHARGED. #9433 is a HIGH-FLIP-RISK slice on a live grant/tenancy door, and this workflow spawns exactly ONE reviewer — so the independent second pass is a MANUAL LEAD STEP before merge. I re-derived the substitution from source and mutation-proved my own guard, but a genuinely independent pair of eyes on the authorization judgment is still owed. Every PR here also carries an open MERGE-GATED criterion that is the lead's to close on merge: #9433[8], #9434[10], #9438[14], #9441[9], #9442[8]. TUI view Email view

320.bodyText: Cloud Console Hardening — wave 28: the instrument fixed “I could not look” at the ROOT and left it standing at the OBJECT — and the environment it runs in is the one place it cannot look Wave 27 was the best-argued wave this epic has run. It refuted both of the lead's headline findings, paid Standing Law 0 by hand with 57 re-parented rows, and proved that the instrument certifying this epic's health was manufacturing false defect reports out of a directory it could not read. Five of its six person-facing slices are on main. One PR is open — #9356 — and it is the one everything else reads through. The lead offered this wave a binary: (a) give the CI job the history the instrument needs, or (b) restructure the red control to assert clause (a) alone. Both are defensible. Both are also incomplete, and this Paper's headline finding is why: measured live, in this session, the WAVE-27-FIXED predicate — the one on #9356, with both of its new refusals armed — still emits six verbatim “commit … is not an ancestor of origin/main” sentences inside a shallow clone. Same disease, same prose, one condition over, in the exact environment the instrument runs in automatically. The wish, and what is already true about each item # THE WISH MEASURED ON ORIGIN/MAIN DFDC31DB9, 2026-08-03T12:35Z 1 #9356 is red because console-harness.yml checks out at fetch-depth:1; decide (a) fetch-depth:0 or (b) restructure the control CONFIRMED and ENLARGED. Depth-1 clone of this repo: origin/main RESOLVES as a ref, but every registered commit is rc 128 “Not a valid object name”. The #9356 predicate passes BOTH of its new refusal legs there and prints six false ancestry sentences at b=FAIL. The binary is false — the fix is the DISCRIMINATION, and it makes both (a) and (b) correct rather than either being a workaround. 2 the D307 door guard is now a wave, not a slice; budget for a `surface` ENUM and a BACKFILL CONFIRMED as filed: cchi-w27-bl-d307-create-time-door-guard, open, 0/5, parent cch-instruments-epic, files [api/lib/barkpark/content/mutations.ex]. apply_mutations is public (mutations.ex:31) and reachable non-admin through MutateController → POST /v1/data/mutate/:dataset (router.ex:2322). The BACKFILL is a ledger write, not code — wave 27 proved the lead's hands are the right instrument for that class. 3 re-derive orphans with the fixed instrument, from a real git tree, quoting UTC stamp + tree sha + RESOLVED ROOT DONE, in this Paper. 2026-08-03T12:35:45Z · tree dfdc31db96b85b66515a1cba3f92a9e9bd81b09b · root <scratchpad>/wt-w28 → NO-SEAL a=FAIL b=PASS c=PASS orphans=57 considering=1 residue=60 (live 59). Wave 27's debrief read 62; five rows have left since. 4 person-facing residue: .preview-url deploy-row siblings; the desktop band; the render-path bypass remainder ONE PREMISE FAILS SMOKE. `.preview-url` is a DOM CHILD of `.deploy-ref` (app.js:10289 emits `<div class="deploy-ref">branch → <a class="preview-url mono">`), and #9357 landed `.deploy-ref { overflow-wrap: anywhere }` at app.css:1847 — whose own committed comment at :1841-1843 says it covers `.preview-url` inside it by inheritance. The next silent clip is NOT there. The desktop band is D323, a measured negative, correctly closed. 5 cch-w22-s7 was split and five criteria stamped by D325; finish or close the remainder against origin/main's bytes D325 is explicit: stamp C6/C7/C8/C12/C14, DROP C9 (its symbol `cuePaints` has zero occurrences under cloud/ and its second anchor file does not exist), close C15/C16 `n/a — split`. This is a LEDGER action for the lead at Decide, not a builder slice. `bp task get cch-w22-s7` returns nothing under that id — resolving the real id is survey work. THE FINDING: wave 27 named the shallow clone in its own fix's header comment, and did not close it seal-predicate.mjs:453 is one line: `try { execFileSync('git', ['-C', REPO, 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', commit, 'origin/main'], …); } catch { problems.push(`commit ${commit} is not an ancestor of origin/main`); }`. The catch is unconditional. Charter D318 enumerated exactly what it swallows — “not-a-git-repo / no-origin-main / shallow-clone / unknown-sha” — and wave 27's fix closed the first two and wrote the other two into a comment. The wave-27 header comment says it out loud, verbatim: “the ancestry `catch` at the top of `verifyCommit` swallows not-a-git-repo, no origin/main, a shallow clone and an unknown sha into one identical claim about the PRODUCT.” The remedy that follows checks that `.github/workflows/cloud.yml` exists and that `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` resolves to REPO. A depth-1 CI clone satisfies both. Grade: A− WHAT EARNS IT. The wave's headline question was a judgment call between two defensible options and it was decided cleanly, then executed without cheating: #9356 is green in a REAL depth-1 clone with the thing that was red still red-able, the fabrication sentences relocated rather than deleted, and an unanchored regex that discriminated nothing repaired on the way past. An INFRA-FAULT prints a=UNKNOWN and will red s1's control — deliberately. The REQUIRED `Console gate` depends on guerrilla.barkpark.cloud being reachable (one live spawn, test 56). s3 documented it; nobody has fixed it. A required gate that a third-party host can red is the same defect class as a guard no job runs. The D307 guard's promotion: the `surface` ENUM plus the backfill of open rows, which is what turns the warn tier hard. Until then “every epic row declares a surface” is false and the code says so. The s7 residue: a re-check affordance for a TERMINAL `unknown` rail, and domainRungChip's missing `unknown` arm (task-1daff7bc1bf46ceb) — a screen reader is still told “waiting” one layer below a rung that says it could not be checked. cch-w22-s7's remainder, finished or closed against origin/main's bytes rather than rebuilt. THE WAVE'S OWN SIXTH CLAUSE, PAID TWICE MORE. Wave 27 added it: an instrument pointed at the wrong ROOT reports defect-shaped prose for a condition that is only “I could not look”. Wave 28 found the same shape in two more places — a test bound to an exit code it does not test, which reported a DEFECT for an ENVIRONMENT, and a resolver classification that would have reported “we could not check” for a domain that was simply still propagating. The fix in both cases was the same move: separate the measurement from the absence of one, and say which you have.

320.title: Cloud Console Hardening — wave 28: the instrument fixed “I could not look” at the root and left it standing at the object

390.bodyText: Cloud Console Hardening — wave 28: the instrument fixed “I could not look” at the ROOT and left it standing at the OBJECT — and the environment it runs in is the one place it cannot look Wave 27 was the best-argued wave this epic has run. It refuted both of the lead's headline findings, paid Standing Law 0 by hand with 57 re-parented rows, and proved that the instrument certifying this epic's health was manufacturing false defect reports out of a directory it could not read. Five of its six person-facing slices are on main. One PR is open — #9356 — and it is the one everything else reads through. The lead offered this wave a binary: (a) give the CI job the history the instrument needs, or (b) restructure the red control to assert clause (a) alone. Both are defensible. Both are also incomplete, and this Paper's headline finding is why: measured live, in this session, the WAVE-27-FIXED predicate — the one on #9356, with both of its new refusals armed — still emits six verbatim “commit … is not an ancestor of origin/main” sentences inside a shallow clone. Same disease, same prose, one condition over, in the exact environment the instrument runs in automatically. The wish, and what is already true about each item # THE WISH MEASURED ON ORIGIN/MAIN DFDC31DB9, 2026-08-03T12:35Z 1 #9356 is red because console-harness.yml checks out at fetch-depth:1; decide (a) fetch-depth:0 or (b) restructure the control CONFIRMED and ENLARGED. Depth-1 clone of this repo: origin/main RESOLVES as a ref, but every registered commit is rc 128 “Not a valid object name”. The #9356 predicate passes BOTH of its new refusal legs there and prints six false ancestry sentences at b=FAIL. The binary is false — the fix is the DISCRIMINATION, and it makes both (a) and (b) correct rather than either being a workaround. 2 the D307 door guard is now a wave, not a slice; budget for a `surface` ENUM and a BACKFILL CONFIRMED as filed: cchi-w27-bl-d307-create-time-door-guard, open, 0/5, parent cch-instruments-epic, files [api/lib/barkpark/content/mutations.ex]. apply_mutations is public (mutations.ex:31) and reachable non-admin through MutateController → POST /v1/data/mutate/:dataset (router.ex:2322). The BACKFILL is a ledger write, not code — wave 27 proved the lead's hands are the right instrument for that class. 3 re-derive orphans with the fixed instrument, from a real git tree, quoting UTC stamp + tree sha + RESOLVED ROOT DONE, in this Paper. 2026-08-03T12:35:45Z · tree dfdc31db96b85b66515a1cba3f92a9e9bd81b09b · root <scratchpad>/wt-w28 → NO-SEAL a=FAIL b=PASS c=PASS orphans=57 considering=1 residue=60 (live 59). Wave 27's debrief read 62; five rows have left since. 4 person-facing residue: .preview-url deploy-row siblings; the desktop band; the render-path bypass remainder ONE PREMISE FAILS SMOKE. `.preview-url` is a DOM CHILD of `.deploy-ref` (app.js:10289 emits `<div class="deploy-ref">branch → <a class="preview-url mono">`), and #9357 landed `.deploy-ref { overflow-wrap: anywhere }` at app.css:1847 — whose own committed comment at :1841-1843 says it covers `.preview-url` inside it by inheritance. The next silent clip is NOT there. The desktop band is D323, a measured negative, correctly closed. 5 cch-w22-s7 was split and five criteria stamped by D325; finish or close the remainder against origin/main's bytes D325 is explicit: stamp C6/C7/C8/C12/C14, DROP C9 (its symbol `cuePaints` has zero occurrences under cloud/ and its second anchor file does not exist), close C15/C16 `n/a — split`. This is a LEDGER action for the lead at Decide, not a builder slice. `bp task get cch-w22-s7` returns nothing under that id — resolving the real id is survey work. THE FINDING: wave 27 named the shallow clone in its own fix's header comment, and did not close it seal-predicate.mjs:453 is one line: `try { execFileSync('git', ['-C', REPO, 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', commit, 'origin/main'], …); } catch { problems.push(`commit ${commit} is not an ancestor of origin/main`); }`. The catch is unconditional. Charter D318 enumerated exactly what it swallows — “not-a-git-repo / no-origin-main / shallow-clone / unknown-sha” — and wave 27's fix closed the first two and wrote the other two into a comment. The wave-27 header comment says it out loud, verbatim: “the ancestry `catch` at the top of `verifyCommit` swallows not-a-git-repo, no origin/main, a shallow clone and an unknown sha into one identical claim about the PRODUCT.” The remedy that follows checks that `.github/workflows/cloud.yml` exists and that `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` resolves to REPO. A depth-1 CI clone satisfies both. Measured live in this session, controlled pair, same live ledger, same minute, nothing varied but the clone: CLONE GIT STATE PREDICATE RESULT full worktree at origin/main not shallow, all objects present origin/main's (pre-#9356) rc 1 · NO-SEAL a=FAIL b=PASS c=PASS orphans=57 `git clone --depth 1` of the same repo is-shallow-repository = true; origin/main RESOLVES; `merge-base --is-ancestor a78fd4e8c origin/main` → rc 128 `fatal: Not a valid object name` #9356's FIXED predicate, both new refusals armed rc 1 · NO-SEAL a=FAIL b=FAIL c=PASS · SIX false “commit … is not an ancestor of origin/main” sentences The instrument that certifies this epic reports “I could not look” as “I found a defect” — the exact sin wave 27 fixed — in the one environment where it runs without a human present. That is not a test failure. It is the sixth standing-test clause, live, on the very instrument that authored it. THE DIRECTION: one disease, two audiences — the console and its instrument both stop asserting what they did not measure This wave has one sentence and it points in both directions at once. A system that could not determine something must say so. It must not substitute a plausible guess, a default, or the negative branch of a two-way test it was unable to run. Pointed at the INSTRUMENT, that sentence resolves the lead's binary by refusing it. Option (a) alone leaves the predicate lying in every other shallow environment — a container, a fork PR, an agent's `--depth 1`, any future job. Option (b) alone leaves standing the fact the lead correctly identified as bigger than the test: that every seal run under this workflow is structurally unable to evaluate clause (b). The answer that pays both is the DISCRIMINATION: teach the git legs to tell rc 1 (“not an ancestor”, an honest answer about the product) from rc 128 / missing object / shallow repository (“I could not look”, an honest answer about the environment). Once the predicate can tell those apart, (b) becomes the correct shape for the control — it asserts the floor it is actually about — and (a) becomes a verified environment declaration rather than a workaround, because a regression back to depth-1 would then produce an honest INFRA-FAULT the job can assert on. Pointed at the PERSON, the same sentence is already sitting in the ledger as open rows. A refused connection is reported as “A network step timed out. Retry usually fixes this.” — the console did not classify the failure, so it guessed, and the guess carries ADVICE. A person switches on “Deployment failed” alerts across email and every chat channel, and the event has zero producers anywhere in the repository — the console tells them they are subscribed to something that cannot arrive. These are not clipping bugs. They are the epic's founding vision, in its purest form, and they are the wave's person bodies. What the finished wave looks like #9356 is MERGED, first and alone, and it merged because its control was restructured to assert clause (a) — the floor it exists to test — not because anything red was weakened. Nothing about the depth-1 environment changed to get it green. The seal predicate has a THIRD refusal in the same discipline as its first two: HISTORY-UNAVAILABLE. Run it in a shallow clone and it exits 2 with a named code and zero invented findings, exactly as it now does in a git-archive extraction. Mutation-proved with a REAL `git clone --depth 1`, not a stub — the wave-27 lesson is that stubbing the leg only moves the failure. console-harness.yml stops being an environment the instrument cannot work in. The seal job declares the history it needs, and a self-check reds if that declaration silently reverts — a guard on the guard's environment, which is the class of defect this whole wave is about. The D307 door guard is ARMED, not ruled on for a third wave. `surface` becomes an enum; the open rows are backfilled BY THE LEAD'S HAND at Decide (wave 27 proved that pattern with 57 re-parents); the fence widening is a numbered charter decision written before a builder touches mutations.ex; and the refusal is scoped to this epic's parent_id so its blast radius is this epic, not the whole task system. At least four — target five — slices where a PERSON is misinformed or cannot reach a control, led by the two rows where the console gives a confident wrong answer to a question it never asked. What this wave deliberately does NOT do It does not spend a slice on `.preview-url`. That premise failed smoke: #9357 already covers it by inheritance and the committed CSS comment says so. Booking it would be paying twice for one fix. It does not chase orphans to zero. 57 is stated with all three provenance facts and repaid only by rows that leave honestly. Wave 27 already made the largest Law-0 payment in the epic's history; a wave spent on ledger hygiene is the disease the charter names at waves 9/10/11. It does not touch .github/required-checks.json, and it registers nothing. The direction debate: three candidates, argued, one committed Rival A — “Finish the instrument, build the door” (the wish read literally) Take the lead's binary, pick one leg, and spend the rest of the wave on the D307 door guard as a full multi-slice build: the `surface` enum, the backfill, the fence ruling, the refusal, the mutation proof. Clean, obedient, and it retires the highest-leverage row in the epic. WHY IT LOSES. Three counts. First, arithmetic: four instrument slices against a floor of four person bodies means eight slices minimum, and this epic's own history says a wave that spends 4-of-6 on instruments moves the row count the wrong way (waves 9/10/11: +11, +16, +7). Second, the door guard's dependency chain — enum → backfill → fence ruling → refusal — is SERIAL and cannot fan out to parallel builders, so it converts a fan-out wave into a queue. Third and worst, it accepts the false binary. Picking (a) or (b) at speed leaves the predicate lying in every shallow environment that is not this one workflow, and this Paper has now proved live that such an environment exists and that the epic's own instrument is in it. Rival B — “Pay Law 0 to zero and drive at the seal” orphans is 57 and a=FAIL is the only clause failing. Spend the wave closing, forwarding and adjudicating residue — including the cch-w22-s7 split D325 already ruled — and get the epic within sight of an honest SEAL. WHY IT LOSES. It is the epic's stated disease wearing a productivity costume. The charter's vision is that the CONSOLE stops lying; a wave with zero person bodies fails the ratio outright and would be the fourth restatement of a law rather than a payment of it. It also mistakes the seal for the goal — D318 proved the predicate could SEAL an epic that does not exist, which means a falling orphan count was never the thing worth optimising. HARVESTED ANYWAY: this Paper quotes the reading with all three provenance facts, and the cch-w22-s7 adjudication is booked as a Decide-phase ledger action for the lead, costing zero builders. Rival C — “One disease, two audiences” — COMMITTED Two instrument slices that pay the environment question properly plus the discrimination that generalises it; one door-guard slice made buildable by moving its backfill dependency onto the lead's hands at Decide; and four-to-five person bodies chosen so that at least two of them are literally the same defect the instrument has — a system asserting a fact it did not measure. WHY IT WINS. It is the only candidate where the instrument work and the person work are the SAME argument, which means the wave's finding transfers: the sentence that fixes the seal predicate is the sentence a builder applies to `connection refused`. It keeps the ratio at four-plus without inventing filler. It refuses the lead's binary on evidence rather than on preference — the depth-1 run is measured, not reasoned. And it ships the door guard ARMED this wave by removing the dependency that blocked it, rather than ruling on it for a third consecutive wave. The sharpest attack on the winner, and how the wave absorbs it “You are deferring the D307 door guard AGAIN. Wave 26 ruled on it, wave 27 filed it, and ‘build the enum, defer the refusal’ is exactly the shape that lets wave 29 defer it a fourth time. Meanwhile you have talked yourself into a THIRD instrument slice nobody asked for.” TAKEN, and it changes the plan rather than being argued away. The wave does not ship the enum and defer the refusal — it ships the refusal ARMED, and it removes the blocker by re-classifying it. D324 gave four honest reasons the guard could not ship: (i) no classifier, (ii) the fence widening is not a builder's call, (iii) CI is post-hoc detection not refusal, (iv) shipping before the backfill makes the guard's first act on main a refusal of legitimate filings. Reasons (i) and (iv) are LEDGER work, and wave 27 proved conclusively that ledger work belongs to the lead's hands at Decide — 57 re-parents, executed in minutes, with the post-condition asserted on the destination roster. Reason (ii) is a numbered charter decision, which is also a Decide-phase artifact. Reason (iii) argues FOR the door, not against it. So the builder's slice is what remains: the enum validation and the refusal, scoped to one parent_id, with a mutation proof that shows it can both refuse and pass. If survey finds the backfill is larger or messier than wave 27's re-parent — a real risk, since `surface` is populated on 24 of 343 rows and is free prose — the wave scopes the guard's population to rows the backfill actually reached and says so, rather than arming a refusal over rows it cannot classify. On the third instrument slice: it is not a third, it is the CORRECT first. Without the discrimination, both of the lead's options are workarounds, and this Paper has the run output proving it. The wave's own ratio discipline still binds — if the discrimination and the environment declaration cannot be shown to be one coherent slice at Decide, the environment half merges with #9356 and the wave spends the recovered budget on a fifth person body. Premise smoke — every inherited premise this direction leans on, run rather than quoted PREMISE (SOURCE) THE CHECK THAT WAS RUN RESULT Wave 27's five slices are on main; only #9356 is open (lead notes, L6) `git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> origin/main` for all six named shas; `gh pr view 9356` CONFIRMED. a78fd4e8c, c4a359d0c, 713795305, 7c8fa229a, 271d4a244, dfdc31db9 all ancestors. #9356 OPEN; `Console gate` and `Console client unit harness` both FAILURE. console-harness.yml checks out at fetch-depth 1 (wish item 1) `git show origin/main:.github/workflows/console-harness.yml` CONFIRMED for console-unit (bare `actions/checkout@v4`, v4's default depth is 1). NUANCE the wish does not carry: the `changes` job at :104 DOES set fetch-depth: 0, so the file already contains the remedy pattern for a different job. A depth-1 clone “has neither origin/main nor those commits” (wish item 1) `git clone --depth 1`; `git branch -r`; `git merge-base --is-ancestor a78fd4e8c origin/main` HALF REFUTED, and the half that fails matters. origin/main DOES exist as a ref in a depth-1 clone. Only the OBJECTS are missing (rc 128 `Not a valid object name`). A remedy that checks “does origin/main resolve?” would therefore pass and change nothing. #9356's fix closes the wrong-root class (D318, wave 27) Copied #9356's predicate into the depth-1 clone and ran it live CONFIRMED for the ROOT class and REFUTED as a general fix. Both new refusal legs PASS in a shallow clone; six false ancestry sentences print anyway. b=FAIL from a clone, b=PASS from a full tree, same ledger, same minute. `.preview-url` is the next silent clip (wish item 4) `git show origin/main:cloud/priv/static/app.css | grep`; `app.js` previewRow FAILS SMOKE — a FINDING, not a foundation. app.css:1847 `.deploy-ref { … overflow-wrap: anywhere }` (landed #9357) and app.js emits `.preview-url` INSIDE `.deploy-ref`. The committed comment at :1841-1843 states the inheritance explicitly. Already paid. The D307 door guard's target is reachable through a real non-admin write path `git grep apply_mutations`; router.ex route table CONFIRMED. `Content.apply_mutations/3` is public at mutations.ex:31; callers are MutateController (POST /v1/data/mutate/:dataset, router.ex:2322), Sync.Applier and papers/value_writeback. Not an admin-only path. mutations.ex:470-545 already hosts a create-time door guard, so the pattern exists in-file. cch-w26-bl-deploy-row-siblings-unwrapped is residue `bp task get` REFUTED. It is DONE at 10/10 — that IS #9357. The residual row the wish is reaching for does not exist under that id. Every code site the direction names still exists on origin/main `git cat-file -e origin/main:<path>` × 9 ALL PRESENT: mutations.ex, sites/deploy.ex, app.js, app.css, scenarios.mjs, overflow-guard.mjs, console-harness.yml, and both wave-27 ledger recipes under tooling/grip/ledger/. Charter D-numbers this direction cites (D307, D317, D318, D319, D321, D322, D324, D325) exist AND cover what they are cited for `git show origin/main:.claude/workflows/…charter.md`, read verbatim ALL PRESENT AND COVERING. D324 in particular authorises exactly the four-reason deferral this direction dismantles, and names `surface` at 24/343 free prose — the number the direction budgets against. Two premises failed smoke and both are stated rather than dropped: `.preview-url` is already paid, and “a depth-1 clone has no origin/main” is false in the half that would have shaped the remedy. One premise was ENLARGED: the wrong-root fix does not generalise, and the proof is a live run rather than an argument. The shape the wave is aiming at — seven named, five expected Tentative. Decide finalises after two exploration rounds; survey may kill any of these and is expected to promote at least one replacement on its own evidence, as wave 27's flick-to-bottom and progressbar bodies were. # CANDIDATE CLASS NOTE 1 #9356 unhostaged — the empty-roster control asserts CLAUSE (a), not the overall verdict instrument Merges FIRST and ALONE. Nothing red is weakened; the control stops being hostage to clauses it does not test. 2 HISTORY-UNAVAILABLE — the git legs tell “not an ancestor” from “I could not look”, mutation-proved in a real `--depth 1` clone instrument The crown. Generalises wave 27's fix to the condition its own comment names. 3 The seal job's environment is DECLARED and its regression is detectable instrument May merge into #2 at Decide if they are one coherent change; the wave's ratio recovers a slice if so. 4 A refused connection stops being reported as a timeout with retry advice PERSON `cch-w27-bl-connection-refused-classified-as-timeout`, open, 0/4. Builder ships enum + refusal + a mutation proof that can both refuse and pass. — A fifth person body PERSON Held open deliberately. D311's `#cred-back` finding (four of five exits fail to resume, fix is path-asymmetric) is the leading candidate to check for whether it was ever built. RATIO: at least four slices where a PERSON is misinformed or cannot reach a control. Items 4, 5, 6 and one survey-promoted body are the four; the wave does not ship if fewer than four survive. The survey plan — 17 assignments, and why each one can change the plan Width is deliberate. Every load-bearing assumption in the direction above appears below as a question a surveyor can answer with a run. KEY THE QUESTION WHY IT CHANGES THE PLAN shallow-clone-discrimination Enumerate EVERY git read seal-predicate.mjs makes (merge-base --is-ancestor :453, git show --format= :429, git show --name-only :432, rev-parse --show-toplevel in assertReadableRepoRoot) and for each establish which exit codes/conditions are an HONEST ANSWER ABOUT THE PRODUCT versus 'I could not look'. Does `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` combined with `git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit}` fully discriminate, or is there a residual case where rc 1 from --is-ancestor is UNTRUSTWORTHY because history is truncated? Then map the shape of a task CREATE mutation as `bp` actually sends it — where does `surface` land in the payload, and is it visible at the same point the existing guard runs? Critically: check whether the existing mutations tests PIN a defect rather than prove a guard (the hazard cchi-w27-bl-d307-create-time-door-guard's criterion 4 names, citing seal-predicate.test.mjs:229-238 as prior art). Determines whether the door guard is one builder slice or three, and whether its test scaffolding is trustworthy or must be rebuilt first. surface-backfill-census Live ledger census: for every OPEN child of cloud-console-hardening-epic AND cch-instruments-epic, report the `surface` value (D324 measured 24 of 343 populated, free prose). Emit the actual proposed backfill map as an executable list so the lead can pay it by hand at Decide the way wave 27 paid 57 re-parents. The backfill is the door guard's hard dependency and the wave's plan moves it to the lead's hands. If it cannot be produced as a mechanical list, the guard slice must shrink to the population the backfill reached. connection-refused-body Read `cch-w27-bl-connection-refused-classified-as-timeout` in full, then trace the classifier: FailureCopy.humanize and merge_job_status/4 in cloud/lib/.../router.ex (~:8460), plus every caller. If no instrument reaches the element, the slice must ship its own cruel fixture in the same commit (D322's ordering law). deployment-failed-toggle Read `cch-w27-bl-deployment-failed-toggle-fires-nothing` in full. Then answer the policy question with evidence: is the honest remedy removing the control, disabling it with a stated reason, or wiring the producer? It also needs a POLICY RULING at Decide, which must be made on measurement, not preference. deploy-detail-remainder Diff c4a359d0c (#9355) precisely and state what it closed of D321(3) — `Sites.Deploy.fail/2` writing one reason to BOTH `failure_reason:` and `detail:` at deploy.ex:970-971 — and D321(4), `broadcast_stage/2` shipping `detail: stage.detail` raw through events.ex. Shipped literally, D332 would have turned the MOST COMMON waiting state into “we could not check” and stripped its propagation advice: one lie swapped for another, in the very rung the slice existed to make honest. NXDOMAIN means the resolver ANSWERED. Fixed with `@answered_empty [:nxdomain]`, and — the half that matters for the standing test — the DNS test fakes now RETURN nxdomain for a missing record instead of `{:ok, []}`, a shape production never produces. task-3fbfff8c97b50c8f is closed with the ruling, its measurement and its residual gap on the record. 3. THE REAP ALERT CAP IS NOW DRIVEN (commit ab2a6dce5). `@reap_alert_cap 25` decides that the 26th owner in a cluster incident hears nothing by email — a person-facing SUPPRESSION that no fixture crossed. The builder flagged it against himself; the review paid it: a test fails 27 deployments in one sweep and asserts exactly 25 emails plus the suppression log line, with `Registry.reap_alert_cap/0` exposed so the test reads the real constant instead of a copy. Mutation-proved: replacing `Enum.split(alerts, @reap_alert_cap)` with `{alerts, []}` reds exactly that test and nothing else. 4. THE MUTATION ANCHORS IN s1's CONTROL (commit 52a80c7be). `String.prototype.replace` on an anchor that has drifted is a SILENT no-op, and `mutatedRun`'s own `notEqual(out, src)` guard would have been satisfied by the roster mutation alone — so a future refactor of seal-predicate.mjs could have left the floor mutation un-applied and the control passing vacuously. Each anchor is now asserted present before use. Orphans, re-derived with the fixed instrument from a real git tree All three things the wish demanded are quoted, not paraphrased. UTC 2026-08-03T14:43:51Z · tree sha 52a80c7be · RESOLVED REPO ROOT /Volumes/SATECHI/github/barkpark/.claude/worktrees/wf_e660e3b7-480-40. VERDICT-TOKEN: SEAL-PREDICATE NO-SEAL a=FAIL b=PASS c=PASS orphans=75 considering=1 successor=cch-instruments-epic epic=cloud-console-hardening-epic mode=live stubbed=0 waived=0 roster=307 head=52a80c7be Roster 307 {done 195, in_progress 7, open 70, cancelled 34, considering 1}. Residue 78 (live 77, considering 1); forwarded under the successor 0; the three permanent human gates all resolve in-roster. b=PASS here because this is a FULL clone. That is the wave's whole finding restated: the same predicate under console-harness.yml still cannot evaluate clause (b) at all, and nothing in CI has changed about that. D306's two integers, as deltas against wave 27's 117 / roster 343 {189, 119, 34, 1} at c2affd445 — RE-PARENTED OUT OF THIS ROSTER = 36 (343 → 307), CLOSED = +6 done (189 → 195). The 36 does not equal wave 27's 57 hand re-parents, and the reconciliation is stated rather than smoothed: 343 − 57 = 286, and ~21 rows were filed INTO the epic since (wave 28's 8 slice rows plus follow-ups), which lands at 307. Orphans fell 117 → 75. Ledger audit Honest across the board, with no corrections owed. Every built slice is `in_progress`, published, with evidence stamped as the builder worked and the merge-gated criterion left open for the lead — s1 6/7, s3 6/7, s4 7/8 (criterion 4 an honest --miss carrying the refuting numbers), s5 7/8, s6 9/10, s7 10/11, s8 7/8. cch-w28-s2 correctly sits `open` as a deferred round-2 slice. Backlog rows filed by builders are published and open. The ONLY ledger mutation this review made was closing task-3fbfff8c97b50c8f with the nxdomain ruling (criteria 0 and 1 stamped with evidence, criterion 2 recorded as an honest --miss and closed over with a written criteria_override rather than graded by its own closer). Grade: A− WHAT EARNS IT. The wave's headline question was a judgment call between two defensible options and it was decided cleanly, then executed without cheating: #9356 is green in a REAL depth-1 clone with the thing that was red still red-able, the fabrication sentences relocated rather than deleted, and an unanchored regex that discriminated nothing repaired on the way past. Three builders reported measurements that CONTRADICTED their own briefs — the 23-failure prediction, the `returning:` prescription, the nxdomain classification — and each filed the contradiction instead of reinterpreting the criterion into something passable. That is the behaviour this epic exists to produce, and it is why the review caught real defects instead of typos. Four person-facing bodies landed with genuine fail-before proofs, and the cross-slice integration is proved by a 2693/0 full-suite run rather than asserted. WHAT HOLDS IT BACK. The instrument is still structurally blind in the only place it runs automatically — s2 was deferred by the sequenced-rounds law, which is correct process, but it means the epic is still certified by a predicate that can only give a partial verdict in CI, and s3 turned that from an unstated fact into a DOCUMENTED one, which by the wave's own standing test is a sentence, not a fix. The D307 door guard shipped armed but its hard tier can reach almost nothing (no fixture outside its own block carries a `surface` key) and its absence tier is a warn, so the filing law still holds because people are careful, not because a door refuses. s7 shipped a person-facing regression in the most common domain state that only review caught — the builder measured it and escalated correctly, but a wave that ships a decision it knows may be wrong is one review away from shipping it for real. And the domain rail now goes TERMINAL on `unknown` with no re-check affordance, which trades a spinning lie for a frozen truth. What the next wave should take MERGE ORDER, and it matters: round 1 first (#9356, then #9404-#9409, which are file-disjoint and all merge cleanly onto main in one probe). ONLY THEN cch-w28-s2 — it rewrites the same file #9356 rewrites and must mutate the discrimination out of #9356's fail-before controls. cch-w28-s2's hard constraint, armed as a tripwire by s1: HISTORY-UNAVAILABLE must surface as a verdict-token LETTER at exit 1, never a process-level exit-2 INFRA-FAULT. An INFRA-FAULT prints a=UNKNOWN and will red s1's control — deliberately. The REQUIRED `Console gate` depends on guerrilla.barkpark.cloud being reachable (one live spawn, test 56). s3 documented it; nobody has fixed it. A required gate that a third-party host can red is the same defect class as a guard no job runs. The D307 guard's promotion: the `surface` ENUM plus the backfill of open rows, which is what turns the warn tier hard. Until then “every epic row declares a surface” is false and the code says so. The s7 residue: a re-check affordance for a TERMINAL `unknown` rail, and domainRungChip's missing `unknown` arm (task-1daff7bc1bf46ceb) — a screen reader is still told “waiting” one layer below a rung that says it could not be checked. cch-w22-s7's remainder, finished or closed against origin/main's bytes rather than rebuilt. THE WAVE'S OWN SIXTH CLAUSE, PAID TWICE MORE. Wave 27 added it: an instrument pointed at the wrong ROOT reports defect-shaped prose for a condition that is only “I could not look”. Wave 28 found the same shape in two more places — a test bound to an exit code it does not test, which reported a DEFECT for an ENVIRONMENT, and a resolver classification that would have reported “we could not check” for a domain that was simply still propagating. The fix in both cases was the same move: separate the measurement from the absence of one, and say which you have.
